label.definition:
n. a brief description given for purposes of identification
n. trade name of a company that produces musical recordings
n. a radioactive isotope that is used in a compound in order to trace the mechanism of a chemical reaction
n. an identifying or descriptive marker that is attached to an object
label.translation: n. 标签, 称号, 商标, 标志\nvt. 贴标签于, 标注\n[计] 标志; 标注; DOS外部命令:用于建立改变或删除磁盘卷标号

examples.en: The contents of the box are listed on the label.
examples.zh: 箱子的内容在标签上面写着。

examples.en: The contents of the box are indicated on the label.
examples.zh: 箱子的内容在标签上面写着。

examples.en: Tom picked up the jar and read the label.
examples.zh: 汤姆拿起罐子读标签。

labor.definition: n. a social class comprising those who do manual labor or work for wages\nn. productive work (especially physical work done for wages)\nv. work hard
labor.translation: n. 劳动, 努力, 工作, 劳工, 分娩\nvi. 劳动, 努力, 苦干\nvt. 详细分析, 使厌烦

examples.en: Labor is not merely a necessity but a pleasure.
examples.zh: 劳动不仅是一种需要，而还是一种愉快。

examples.en: Capital, land and labor are the three key factors of production.
examples.zh: 资本、土地和劳动是生产的三大要素。

examples.en: He is reaping the fruits of his labor.
examples.zh: 他在收获他的劳动果实。

laboratory.definition: n a workplace for the conduct of scientific research\nn a region resembling a laboratory inasmuch as it offers opportunities for observation and practice and experimentation
laboratory.translation: n. 实验室, 研究室, 化工厂\n[医] 实验室, 检验室, 化验室

examples.en: Let's first talk about the experiments done in the laboratory.
examples.zh: 让我们先谈谈在实验室中做的实验。

examples.en: This is a chemistry laboratory in an ordinary secondary school.
examples.zh: 这里是普通中学的化学实验室。

examples.en: A series of blasts reduced the laboratory to ruins.
examples.zh: 一连串的爆炸使实验室成为废墟。

lack.definition: n. the state of needing something that is absent or unavailable
lack.translation: n. 缺乏, 无, 不足\nvt. 缺乏, 短少, 不足, 需要\nvi. 缺乏

examples.en: The lack of money is the root of all evil.
examples.zh: 所有的罪恶源于金钱的不足

examples.en: Due to a lack of balance the ship turned over.
examples.zh: 那艘船失去平衡，翻了过来。

examples.en: The museum had to close due to lack of finances.
examples.zh: 博物馆资金不足，只好关门。

ladder.definition: n. steps consisting of two parallel members connected by rungs; for climbing up or down\nn. ascending stages by which somebody or something can progress\nv. come unraveled or undone as if by snagging
ladder.translation: n. 梯, 梯状物, 发迹的途径\nvi. 袜子抽丝, 成名

examples.en: He lost his balance and fell off the ladder.
examples.zh: 他失去了平衡，从梯子上摔了下来。

examples.en: The boy seized the ladder, and began to climb.
examples.zh: 男孩登上了梯子，向上爬了起来。

examples.en: Is this ladder strong enough to bear my weight?
examples.zh: 这个梯子是否足够坚固以承受我的重量？

lady.definition: n. a polite name for any woman\nn. a woman of the peerage in Britain
lady.translation: n. 淑女, 夫人, 女士, 贵妇

examples.en: He helped an old lady get up from her seat.
examples.zh: 他帮忙一位老太太从位子上站起来。

examples.en: It is my pleasure to wait for a beautiful lady.
examples.zh: 等待一位漂亮的姑娘是我的荣幸。

examples.en: This is the lady who wants to see you.
examples.zh: 这位就是谁想见你的夫人。

lag.definition: v. hang (back) or fall (behind) in movement, progress, development, etc.\nv. throw or pitch at a mark, as with coins\nv. cover with lagging to prevent heat loss
lag.translation:
n. 落后, 囚犯, 迟延, 桶板, 防护套
a. 最后的
vi. 落后, 蹒跚, 缓缓而行, 滞后
vt. 落后于, 押往监狱, 加上外套
[计] 延迟; 落后

examples.en: I feel exhausted because of jet lag.
examples.zh: 我因为时差而感到疲惫。

examples.en: We should read the newspaper so as not to lag behind the times.
examples.zh: 我们应该读报纸，不落后于时代。

examples.en: According to one study, Amazon's sales go down by 1% for every 100-millisecond lag in its loading times.
examples.zh: 有研究称，打开速度每慢100毫秒，Amazon 的销售额就下降1%。

lake.definition: n. a body of (usually fresh) water surrounded by land\nn. a purplish red pigment prepared from lac or cochineal\nn. any of numerous bright translucent organic pigments
lake.translation: n. 湖, 池, 色淀\nv. (使)血球溶解

examples.en: The weather was so cold that the lake froze over.
examples.zh: 天冷得足以让湖结冰。

examples.en: Drop by drop, the water can conglomerate into a lake.
examples.zh: 一滴滴水能聚成湖泊。

examples.en: There are a lot of fish in that lake.
examples.zh: 那片湖里有很多鱼。

lamb.definition:
n. young sheep
n. English essayist (1775-1834)
n. a person easily deceived or cheated (especially in financial matters)
n. a sweet innocent mild-mannered person (especially a child)
lamb.translation: n. 小羊, 羔羊\nv. 产羊羔

examples.en: I like to eat lamb kebabs.
examples.zh: 我喜欢吃烤羊肉串。

examples.en: I like beef more than lamb.
examples.zh: 比起羊肉我更喜欢牛肉。

examples.en: I like eating grilled lamb skewers.
examples.zh: 我喜欢吃烤羊肉串。

lame.definition: n. a fabric interwoven with threads of metal
lame.translation: a. 跛足的, 僵痛的, 不完全的, 金属薄板, 不知内情的人\nvi. 变跛\nvt. 使成残废, 使无用

examples.en: The new Harry Potter movie is pretty lame.
examples.zh: 哈利波特的新片十分差。

lament.definition: n. a cry of sorrow and grief\nv. express grief verbally
lament.translation: n. 悲叹, 悔恨, 恸哭, 挽歌, 悼词\nvt. 哀悼\nvi. 悔恨, 悲叹

examples.en: We lament, complain, moan and start crying out in pain.
The rapper Tamer Nafar wrote a beautiful lament for him.
One should not lament over past mistakes too long.

lamp.definition: n. an artificial source of visible illumination\nn. a piece of furniture holding one or more electric light bulbs
lamp.translation: n. 灯\nvt. 照亮\n[计] 逻辑模拟分析系统

examples.en: The lamp was suspended from the branch of a tree.
examples.zh: 灯笼在树枝上吊着。

examples.en: All the oil in the lamp has been used.
examples.zh: 灯里的油用完了。

examples.en: If only that lamp weren't shining in my eye.
examples.zh: 要是那灯泡不照我的眼就好了。

land.definition:
n. the land on which real estate is located
n. material in the top layer of the surface of the earth in which plants can grow (especially with reference to its quality or use)
n. the solid part of the earth's surface
n. United States inventor who incorporated Polaroid film into lenses and invented the one step photographic process (1909-1991)
land.translation:
n. 陆地, 地面, 地界, 地产, 国土, 土地
vi. 登陆, 登岸, 到达
vt. 使上岸, 使登陆, 使到达
[计] 连接盘; 焊盘

examples.en: His goal in buying land is to build a house.
examples.zh: 他买土地的目的是要造房子。

examples.en: Whales are said to have lived on land long ago.
examples.zh: 据说鲸鱼以前是在陆地上生活的。

examples.en: He bought land for the purpose of building a house.
examples.zh: 他买土地的目的是要造房子。

landlord.definition: n. a landowner who leases to others
landlord.translation: n. 房东, 地主\n[经] 业主, 地主, 房东

examples.en: Why hasn't the landlord come to collect rent this month?
examples.zh: 为什么这个月房东还不来收房租？

examples.en: The landlord says he wants to raise the rent.
examples.zh: 东家说要提高租金。

examples.en: Why did my sixty-year-old landlord buy a trampoline?
examples.zh: 我的六十岁的房东为什么买了一个蹦床？

landmark.definition:
n. the position of a prominent or well-known object in a particular landscape
n. an event marking a unique or important historical change of course or one on which important developments depend
n. a mark showing the boundary of a piece of land
n. an anatomical structure used as a point of origin in locating other anatomical structures (as in surgery) or as point from which measurements can be taken
landmark.translation: n. 陆标, 划时代的事, 地界标\n[医] 界标

examples.en: A historical landmark has been restored and will reopen.
examples.zh: 一座历史地标已经修复并将重新开放。

landscape.definition:
n. an expanse of scenery that can be seen in a single view
n. painting depicting an expanse of natural scenery
n. a genre of art dealing with the depiction of natural scenery
n. an extensive mental viewpoint
landscape.translation:
n. 风景, 山水, 风景画
vi. 从事景观美化
vt. 美化...景观
[计] 横向

examples.en: Sun lights the landscape, pain illuminates the soul.
examples.zh: 阳光照亮田野，痛苦点亮心灵。

examples.en: The strawberry tree is a commonly used landscape plant in this area.
examples.zh: 草莓树是该地区常见的景观植物。

examples.en: The landscape is unfamiliar to me.
examples.zh: 风景对我来说很陌生。

lane.definition: n. a narrow way or road\nn. a well-defined track or path; for e.g. swimmers or lines of traffic
lane.translation: n. 小路, 巷, 弄, 单行道

examples.en: Leaves lay thick in the lane.
examples.zh: 小路上舖满了落叶。

examples.en: Are there any bike lanes in Algiers?
examples.zh: 阿尔及尔有自行车道吗？

examples.en: Get into the left lane to make room for the guy who's trying to merge.
examples.zh: 移到左线，为想并入的那辆车腾出空间。

language.definition: n. a systematic means of communicating by the use of sounds or conventional symbols\nn. the mental faculty or power of vocal communication
language.translation: n. 语言, 文字, 措辞\n[计] 语言

examples.en: Do you think this is a language or a dialect?
examples.zh: 你认为这是语言还是方言？

examples.en: What language do you want to talk in with me?
examples.zh: 你想用什么语言和我交谈？

examples.en: What one has to learn is more than the language.
examples.zh: 人人需要学习的不仅仅是语言。

lantern.definition: n. light in a transparent protective case
lantern.translation: n. 灯笼, 提灯, 航标灯\nvt. 装上提灯

examples.en: It is a must to guess lantern riddles during the Lantern Festival.
examples.zh: 元宵节要猜灯谜。

lap.definition:
n. the upper side of the thighs of a seated person
n. an area of control or responsibility
n. the part of a piece of clothing that covers the thighs
n. a flap that lies over another part
lap.translation:
n. 膝盖, 舔, 一圈, 下摆, 衣兜, 山坳
vi. 重叠, 围住, 轻拍, 舔
vt. 包围, 抱...在膝上, 使重叠, 舔, 拍打, 泼溅
[计] 链接访问程序

examples.en: No matter how much you lap coal, it stays black.
You could sit on my lap if you want.
She was brought up in the lap of luxury.

large.definition:
n. a garment size for a large person
a. above average in size or number or quantity or magnitude or extent
s. fairly large or important in effect; influential
s. having broad power and range and scope
large.translation: a. 大的, 大量的, 宽大的, 广博的\nadv. 大大地, 夸大地

examples.en: Ziri saw a large claw mark on the oak tree.
examples.zh: 齐里看到橡树上有一个很大的爪痕。

examples.en: The living room in my new house is very large.
examples.zh: 我新家的客厅很宽敞。

examples.en: My room is small, but it's large enough for me.
examples.zh: 我的房间很小，但对我来说已经够大了。

largely.definition: r. in large part; mainly or chiefly\nr. on a large scale
largely.translation: adv. 大量地, 很多地, 大半地

examples.en: The taste of wine is largely dependent upon the weather.
examples.zh: 葡萄酒的味道很受天气影响。

examples.en: The audience was largely made up of very young children.
examples.zh: 大部分观众是年幼的儿童。

laser.definition: n. an acronym for light amplification by stimulated emission of radiation; an optical device that produces an intense monochromatic beam of coherent light
laser.translation: n. 激光\n[计] 激光器

examples.en: Laser printers are generally cheaper to maintain than inkjet printers.
examples.zh: 激光打印机一般比喷墨打印机用起来更省钱。

examples.en: The laser cow in WHAT THE CAR? is both hilarious and terrifying!
examples.zh: 《WHAT THE CAR?》中的雷射奶牛又好笑又吓人！

examples.en: I'm checking for laser beam alarm triggers.
examples.zh: 我在检查这里有没有激光警报装置。

lash.definition: n. leather strip that forms the flexible part of a whip\nv. lash or flick about sharply\nv. bind with a rope, chain, or cord
lash.translation: n. 鞭子, 鞭打, 睫毛, 责骂, 讽刺\nvt. 鞭打, 摆动, 扎捆, 冲击, 讽刺, 煽动\nvi. 冲洗, 鞭打, 责骂

examples.en: Come on, let's go out on the lash in Paris.
The day after our night on the lash, we felt awful.
Dmitri felt bad that he lashed out at the kid.

last.definition:
n. the last or lowest in an ordering or series
n. a person's dying act; the final thing a person can do
n. a unit of weight equal to 4,000 pounds
n. a unit of capacity for grain equal to 80 bushels
last.translation:
a. 最后的, 末尾的, 最近的
vi. 持续, 支持, 维持
vt. 使维持, 够...用
adv. 最后, 后来
n. 最后, 末尾, 鞋楦头

examples.en: I was the last one to turn in my test.
examples.zh: 我是最后交的考试卷。

examples.en: Tom was the last one to get in the van.
examples.zh: 汤姆是最后一个上面包车的。

examples.en: This last song is one I wrote for my wife.
examples.zh: 最后一首歌是我为妻子写的一首。

latch.definition: n. spring-loaded doorlock that can only be opened from the outside with a key\nn. catch for fastening a door or gate; a bar that can be lowered or slid into a groove\nv. fasten with a latch
latch.translation:
n. 门闩
vi. 上闩, 抓住, 占有
vt. 闩上
[计] 门闩线路; 锁存器

examples.en: Can you fix the latch on my front door?
Pull the bobbin, and the latch will go up.
There was only a flimsy latch on the gate.

late.definition:
a. being or occurring at an advanced period of time or after a usual or expected time
s. of the immediate past or just previous to the present time
s. having died recently
a. of a later stage in the development of a language or literature; used especially of dead languages
late.translation: a. 迟的, 晚的, 已故的\nadv. 很晚, 很迟, 晚

examples.en: How come you call on us so late at night?
examples.zh: 你怎么这么晚才来看我们？

examples.en: I was late as a result of the train delay.
examples.zh: 由于火车延误，我迟到了。

examples.en: So as to avoid being late, we went by car.
examples.zh: 我们乘车去以免迟到

examples.en: There has been a lot of stress at work lately.
examples.zh: 最近工作压力太大了。

examples.en: Tom has been under a great deal of strain lately.
examples.zh: 汤姆最近压力特别大。

examples.en: I've had a lot of work to do lately.
examples.zh: 我最近有很多事情要做。

latent.definition: s. potentially existing but not presently evident or realized\ns. (pathology) not presently active
latent.translation: a. 潜伏性的, 隐藏的\nn. 隐约指纹

examples.en: There are many latent gays among rampant homophobes.
You have a latent problem here that will cause trouble in the future.
Sadists are latent masochists.

lateral.definition: s. situated at or extending to the side\ns. lying away from the median and sagittal plane of a body
lateral.translation: n. 侧部, 支线, 边音\na. 侧面的, 旁边的

examples.en: Dr. Hawking was diagnosed with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis while at Oxford.
The lateral malleolus is the bone on the outside of the ankle joint.
The lateral cerebral ventricles are large cavities within the brain that produce cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).

latitude.definition:
n. the angular distance between an imaginary line around a heavenly body parallel to its equator and the equator itself
n. freedom from normal restraints in conduct
n. an imaginary line around the Earth parallel to the equator
n. scope for freedom of e.g. action or thought; freedom from restriction
latitude.translation: n. 纬度, 范围\n[化] 宽容度; 伟度

examples.en: Algeria is at the same latitude as Washington DC.
Please give me some latitude this time.
Please give us some latitude this time.

latter.definition: n. the second of two or the second mentioned of two\na. referring to the second of two things or persons mentioned (or the last one or ones of several)
latter.translation: a. 后者的, 较后的, 近来的

examples.en: I prefer Noh to Kabuki because I find the former to be more elegant than the latter.
examples.zh: 比起歌舞伎，我更喜欢能乐表演，因为我觉得后者比前者优雅。

examples.en: Practice is as important as theory, but we are apt to value the latter and despise the former.
examples.zh: 实践和理论同样重要，但我们倾向于重视后者而忽略前者。

examples.en: The difference between a standalone sentence and a sentence in the middle of an essay is that the latter has context.
examples.zh: 独立的句子和文章中的句子的区别在于后者具备上下文。

laugh.definition: n. the sound of laughing\nn. a facial expression characteristic of a person laughing\nv. produce laughter
laugh.translation: n. 笑, 笑声\nvi. 笑, 大笑\nvt. 以笑表示

examples.en: I don't like the way you laugh at her.
examples.zh: 我不喜欢你嘲笑她的方式。

examples.en: I don't know if I should cry or laugh.
examples.zh: 我不知道我该哭还是该笑。

examples.en: I don't know whether to cry or to laugh.
examples.zh: 我真是哭笑不得了。

laughter.definition: n. the activity of laughing; the manifestation of joy or mirth or scorn
laughter.translation: n. 笑, 笑声\n[医] 笑, 大笑

examples.en: The boy was not humiliated by the laughter of his classmates.
examples.zh: 那个男孩没有因为他同学的笑而谦卑。

examples.en: A day without laughter is a day wasted.
examples.zh: 没有笑声的一天肯定是最为虚度的一天。

examples.en: Is laughter a quality of man only?
examples.zh: 笑是人类特有的吗？

launch.definition:
n. a motorboat with an open deck or a half deck
v. propel with force
v. launch for the first time; launch on a maiden voyage
v. get going; give impetus to
launch.translation: n. 下水, 汽艇, 发射\nvt. 使下水, 发射, 发动\nvi. 起飞, 下水, 投入, 开始

examples.en: The launch was successful. We're now leaving the solar system.
examples.zh: 发射成功。我们正在离开太阳系。

examples.en: They are going to launch an artificial satellite tomorrow.
examples.zh: 明天将要发射一颗人造卫星。

examples.en: Recently, this brand launched a series of limited edition underwear.
examples.zh: 最近这个品牌推出了一系列限量版内衣。

laundry.definition: n. garments or white goods that can be cleaned by laundering\nn. workplace where clothes are washed and ironed
laundry.translation: n. 洗衣店, 洗好的衣服, 洗涤\n[机] 洗衣作, 洗衣店, 洗衣房

examples.en: Could you send someone up to pick up some laundry?
examples.zh: 你能派人拿一些衣服，好吗？

examples.en: I have to do laundry while it's still sunny.
examples.zh: 趁还有太阳的时候，我该洗衣服。

examples.en: I don't like to use liquid laundry detergent.
examples.zh: 我不喜欢用洗衣液。

lavish.definition: v. expend profusely; also used with abstract nouns\ns. very generous\ns. characterized by extravagance and profusion
lavish.translation: a. 大方的, 丰富的, 浪费的\nvt. 浪费, 滥用, 慷慨给予

examples.en: I am throwing a lavish party for my sixteenth birthday.
Honey, you're lavish with my time, I need to work now.
Tom and Mary had a lavish wedding with no expense spared.

law.definition:
n. the collection of rules imposed by authority
n. legal document setting forth rules governing a particular kind of activity
n. a rule or body of rules of conduct inherent in human nature and essential to or binding upon human society
n. a generalization that describes recurring facts or events in nature
law.translation: n. 法律, 法则, 定律, 法律的制约, 法学, 司法界, 诉讼\nv. 起诉

examples.en: We are equal in the eyes of the law.
examples.zh: 法律面前人人平等。

examples.en: He must be fined if he breaks the law.
examples.zh: 如果他犯了罪，他应该受到惩罚。

examples.en: We should always act in obedience to the law.
examples.zh: 我们无论如何也应该遵守法律。

lawn.definition: n. a field of cultivated and mowed grass
lawn.translation: n. 草地, 草坪, 上等细麻布\n[机] 细筛

examples.en: I didn't charge Tom anything to mow his lawn.
examples.zh: 我修剪汤姆的草坪，没有向他收取任何费用。

examples.en: I'm going to mow the lawn tomorrow, weather permitting.
examples.zh: 如果天气情况允许的话，我明天就去割草坪。

examples.en: Mother told me to mow the lawn.
examples.zh: 妈妈叫我修剪草坪。

lawsuit.definition: n. a comprehensive term for any proceeding in a court of law whereby an individual seeks a legal remedy
lawsuit.translation: n. 诉讼\n[法] 诉讼, 诉讼案件

examples.en: How do I file a lawsuit in the United States.
The lawsuit is likely to end in our defeat.
It's very likely that we will win the lawsuit.

lawyer.definition: n. a professional person authorized to practice law; conducts lawsuits or gives legal advice

examples.en: I have a feeling you'll be a very good lawyer.
examples.zh: 我感觉你将来会成为一名优秀的律师。

examples.en: I'm not saying anything until I speak with my lawyer.
examples.zh: 在我与律师谈过之前，我什么都不会说。

examples.en: I know a good lawyer who can help you.
examples.zh: 我认识一个不错的律师，他可以帮你。

lay.definition:
v. put in a horizontal position
v. prepare or position for action or operation
v. lay eggs
v. impose as a duty, burden, or punishment
lay.translation:
vt. 放置, 产, 铺设, 布置, 提出, 平息
vi. 下蛋, 打赌
n. 位置, 层, 隐藏处

examples.en: The moment she'd finished, she lay down for a nap.
examples.zh: 她刚结束，就躺下打了个盹儿。

examples.zh: 台子上有个发霉的面包。

examples.en: She will lay the doll on her bed.
examples.zh: 她会把娃娃放到她的床上。

layer.definition:
n. single thickness of usually some homogeneous substance
n. a relatively thin sheetlike expanse or region lying over or under another
n. a hen that lays eggs
n. thin structure composed of a single thickness of cells
layer.translation: n. 层, 产卵鸡, 放置者\nvt. 分层堆积, 压植\n[计] 层

examples.en: The deep layers of the ocean are still almost unexplored.
examples.zh: 海洋的深层仍然几乎未被探索。

examples.en: Gently layer gold eyeshadow on the eyelids.
examples.zh: 在眼皮上轻轻叠加金色眼影。

examples.en: As this is a cascade with multiple layers, it shouldn't be surprising that it's slow.
examples.zh: 因为这是一个有好几层的瀑布，所以速度慢也不会让人惊讶。

layout.definition: n. a plan or design of something that is laid out\nn. the act of laying out (as by making plans for something)
layout.translation: n. 布局, 陈列, 规划图, 页面布局, 版面编排\n[计] 页面布局, 版面

examples.en: I've changed my website's layout.
examples.zh: 我改了一下我网站的版面设计。

lazy.translation: a. 懒惰的, 怠惰的, 缓慢的\nvi. 懒散

examples.en: This morning, I was very lazy and didn't go out.
examples.zh: 今天早上我因为太懒而没有出门。

examples.en: The quick brown fox didn't jump over the lazy dog.
examples.zh: 身手矫健的棕狐狸没有跃过懒洋洋的狗。

examples.en: The quick brown fox jumped over the lazy brown dog.
examples.zh: 身手矫健的棕狐狸跃过懒洋洋的棕狗。

lead.definition:
n. an advantage held by a competitor in a race
n. a soft heavy toxic malleable metallic element; bluish white when freshly cut but tarnishes readily to dull grey
n. evidence pointing to a possible solution
n. a position of leadership (especially in the phrase `take the lead')
lead.translation:
n. 铅, 铅条, 领导, 超前量, 领引, 榜样, 主角, 导线
vt. 引导, 带领, 领导, 指挥, 致使, 加铅于, 用铅包
vi. 领导, 带头, 导致, 用测深锤测深, 被铅覆盖
a. 带头的, 最重要的

examples.en: Driving on a slippery road can lead to a car wreck.
examples.zh: 在光滑的路上开车会导致车祸。

examples.en: This road will lead you to the airport.
examples.zh: 这条路是去机场的。

examples.en: Reckless driving can easily lead to an accident.
examples.zh: 鲁莽的开车容易造成交通事故

leader.definition: n. a person who rules or guides or inspires others
leader.translation: n. 领导者, 社论, 指挥, 领袖, 领唱者, 前导字符\n[计] 前导字符

examples.en: A wise leader knows when to listen to others.
examples.zh: 聪明的领袖知道什么时候要听取他人意见。

examples.en: Japan is a leader in the world's high-tech industry.
examples.zh: 日本是世界高科技产业的领头人。

examples.en: Cyber activists want to meet with the Supreme Leader.
examples.zh: 网络积极分子想跟最高领袖见面。

leadership.definition:
n. the activity of leading
n. the body of people who lead a group
n. the status of a leader
n. the ability to lead
leadership.translation: n. 领导能力, 领导阶层

examples.en: For us, what’s most important is understanding the intention of the leadership.
examples.zh: 对我们来说，最重要的是领会领导意图。

examples.en: Tom was born with leadership ability.
examples.zh: 汤姆天生具有领导能力。

examples.en: The students admire her leadership skills.
examples.zh: 学生们佩服她的领导能力。

leaf.definition:
n. the main organ of photosynthesis and transpiration in higher plants
n. a sheet of any written or printed material (especially in a manuscript or book)
n. hinged or detachable flat section (as of a table or door)
v. turn over pages
leaf.translation: n. 叶, 树叶, 花瓣, 页\nvi. 生叶, 翻书页\nvt. 在...上长叶, 翻...的页

examples.en: A fallen leaf floated on the surface of the water.
examples.zh: 水面浮着一片落叶。

examples.en: I'll turn over a new leaf and study English very hard.
examples.zh: 我会重新开始，努力学习英语。

examples.en: The leaves will turn red in two or three weeks.
examples.zh: 再过两三周，树叶就会变红吧。

league.definition:
n. an association of sports teams that organizes matches for its members
n. an association of states or organizations or individuals for common action
n. an obsolete unit of distance of variable length (usually 3 miles)
v. unite to form a league
league.translation: n. 同盟, 联盟, 盟约\nv. 组联盟, (使)加盟

examples.en: All the top teams in England are in the Premier League.
examples.zh: 英国所有的顶尖球队都在超级联赛中。

examples.en: Tom is out of your league.
examples.zh: 汤姆不在你的联盟里。

examples.en: Because all of the teams in the Premier League are really strong, the goal difference is usually small.
examples.zh: 因为在甲级联赛中，所有队伍都很有实力，净胜球差异很小。

leak.definition:
n. an accidental hole that allows something (fluid or light etc.) to enter or escape
n. soft watery rot in fruits and vegetables caused by fungi
n. a euphemism for urination
n. unauthorized (especially deliberate) disclosure of confidential information
leak.translation: n. 漏洞, 漏处, 漏出, 泄漏\nvi. 漏, 泄漏\nvt. 使渗漏

examples.en: The explosion may have been caused by a gas leak.
examples.zh: 这场爆炸有可能是瓦斯外泄引起的。

examples.en: Don't let this information leak out.
examples.zh: 不要把这些资料泄露出去。

examples.en: Every time it rains, the roof leaks.
examples.zh: 每次下雨屋顶就漏水。

lean.definition:
v. to incline or bend from a vertical position
v. cause to lean or incline
v. rely on for support
a. lacking in mineral content or combustible material
lean.translation:
n. 瘦肉, 倾斜, 倾斜度
a. 瘦的, 贫乏的, 歉收的
vi. 倚靠, 倾斜, 依赖
vt. 使倾斜

examples.en: Lend me your shoulder for me to lean on.
examples.zh: 把你的肩膀借给我让我依靠。

examples.en: Don't lean against the wall.
examples.zh: 别倚著墙。

examples.en: The tower leaned slightly to the west.
examples.zh: 塔有点向西边倾斜。

leap.definition:
n. a light, self-propelled movement upwards or forwards
n. an abrupt transition
n. the distance leaped (or to be leaped)
v. pass abruptly from one state or topic to another
leap.translation: n. 跳跃, 剧增, 急变, 被越过之物\nvi. 跳跃, 突然经过\nvt. 跃过, 使跃过

examples.en: Ken leapt over the wall.
examples.zh: 肯跳过了墙。

learn.definition: v. gain knowledge or skills\nv. get to know or become aware of, usually accidentally\nv. be a student of a certain subject

examples.zh: 不管一个人有多老，他都能学习。

examples.en: French is too hard. I don't want to learn it.
examples.zh: 法语太难了，我不想学。

examples.en: Tom went to school to learn how to tune pianos.
examples.zh: 汤姆去学校学习调琴手艺。

learned.definition:

v impart skills or knowledge to
v find out, learn, or determine with certainty, usually by making an inquiry or other effort

a established by conditioning or learning

examples.en: Tom learned to ride a bike when he was ten.
examples.zh: 汤姆在10岁的时候就学骑了自行车。

examples.zh: 我十岁的时候学会了弹结他。

examples.en: We will have learned English for five years next year.
examples.zh: 到明年我们学英语就有5年了。

lease.definition:

examples.en: I signed the lease today.
examples.zh: 我今天签了租约。

least.translation: n. 最少, 最小, 最小限度\na. 最少的, 最小的\nadv. 最小, 最少

examples.zh: 我每天至少用一次煎锅。

examples.en: I go to the library at least once a week.
examples.zh: 我每周至少去图书馆一次。

examples.en: Tom is at least one head taller than I am.
examples.zh: 汤姆起码比我高一个头。

leather.definition: n. an animal skin made smooth and flexible by removing the hair and then tanning\nv. whip with a leather strap

examples.zh: 汤姆买了一双黑色皮鞋。

examples.en: Artificial leather can't compare with the real thing.
examples.zh: 人造皮革是比不上真皮的。

examples.en: I bought a pair of leather gloves.
examples.zh: 我买了一双皮手套。

leave.definition:
n. the period of time during which you are absent from work or duty
n. permission to do something
v. go away from a place
v. go and leave behind, either intentionally or by neglect or forgetfulness
leave.translation: n. 许可, 告别, 请假, 休假\nvt. 离开, 剩下, 遗忘, 委托, 丢弃\nvi. 出发, 离开, 生叶

examples.en: If one day you leave, I will be very sad.
examples.zh: 如果有一天你走了，我会很难过的。

examples.en: I love her so much that I can't leave her.
examples.zh: 我如此地爱她所以我无法离开她。

examples.en: I don't like to leave things up in the air.
examples.zh: 我不喜欢让事情悬而未决。

lecture.definition:
n. a speech that is open to the public
n. a lengthy rebuke
n. teaching by giving a discourse on some subject (typically to a class)

examples.zh: 我们没有必要出席这个讲座。

examples.zh: 听讲座时，你应该保持安静。

examples.en: It isn't necessary for us to attend this lecture.
examples.zh: 我们没有必要出席这个讲座。

left.definition:

examples.zh: 我一离开家就遇见了她。

Skating is part of my blood. It's my family legacy.

a. of or relating to jurisprudence
s. having legal efficacy or force
a. relating to or characteristic of the profession of law

examples.zh: 在加拿大不满20岁饮酒不合法。

examples.zh: 律师们会力劝家长们采取进一步的法律行动。

examples.zh: 美国的司法制度是世界上最好的。

legend.definition: n. a story about mythical or supernatural beings or events
legend.translation: n. 传说, 传奇文学, 图例\n[计] 图例

examples.zh: 肯尼迪总统被刺杀了，但是他的传奇会永久长存。

examples.zh: 神话和传说应该一代一代的传承下去。

examples.en: "Anyone can be a legend."
examples.zh: “每个人都能成为奇迹。”

legislation.definition: n. law enacted by a legislative body\nn. the act of making or enacting laws

examples.zh: 美国总统有权否决与退回法案。

Which prince is the legitimate heir to the throne?

leisure.definition: n. time available for ease and relaxation\nn. freedom to choose a pastime or enjoyable activity

examples.zh: 我常常在我的闲暇时候听广播。

examples.zh: 我一没钱，二没时间。

examples.zh: 她利用空闲时间做布娃娃。

examples.zh: 柠檬有独特的味道。

examples.zh: 你要喝什么茶？泡壶柠檬红茶好吧？

examples.zh: 加入蜂蜜，柠檬汁，切碎的杏仁和切碎的苹果。

examples.zh: 你想用这支笔，我就借给你吧。

examples.zh: 你能借我你的CD播放机一小时吗？

examples.zh: 我不确定那座桥到底有多长。

examples.en: Her hair grew back to its original length.
examples.zh: 她的头发长回原来的长度了。

examples.zh: 这艘船的长度是30米。

examples.zh: 图像在镜片中呈反向。

examples.zh: 我在找我的隐形眼镜。

less.definition:
a. (comparative of `little' usually used with mass nouns) a quantifier meaning not as great in amount or degree
s. (usually preceded by `no') lower in quality
s. (nonstandard in some uses but often idiomatic with measure phrases) fewer
r. used to form the comparative of some adjectives and adverbs

adv. 较少, 较小, 较差

examples.zh: 虽然她有些缺点，但我始终还是爱她。

examples.zh: 他随身带著不少于两千日元。

lessen.definition: v decrease in size, extent, or range\nv make smaller\nv wear off or die down

examples.zh: 这是一栋只出租不出售的房子。

examples.zh: 汤姆让我们知道他需要做。

examples.zh: 尽早让我知道结果。

lethal.definition: s of an instrument of certain death

letter.definition:

letter.translation:
n. 信, 字母, 证书, 字面意义, 铅字, 学问, 出租人
vt. 写字母于, 在...上刻字母, 用字母标明
vi. 写印刷体字
[计] 字母

examples.zh: 用英文写情书是不容易的。

examples.zh: 你到了之后请马上给我写一封信。

n. 水平, 水准, 平地
a. 同高的, 平坦的, 齐平的, 水平的
vt. 弄平, 夷平, 使同等, 瞄准, 对准
vi. 变平, 拉平
[计] 级别

examples.zh: 她的演技堪比专业人士。
