v. supplement with leverage
leverage.translation: n. 杠杆作用, 杠杆装置, 杠杆效率\n[医] 杠杆率

examples.en: Leverage is to debt as lever is to what?
We need leverage if we're going to lift this.
Many conspiracy theorists leverage unverifiable statements and claim them as facts.

levy.definition: n. a charge imposed and collected\nn. the act of drafting into military service\nv. impose and collect
levy.translation: n. 税款, 所征的人数, 征收\nvi. 征税, 课税\nvt. 征收, 强求, 召集

examples.en: Gideon Levy says that Israel is not a democracy.
The airport improvement levy seems higher than last year.
The government levied a new tax on luxury goods.

liability.definition: n. the state of being legally obliged and responsible\nn. the quality of being something that holds you back
liability.translation: n. 责任, 债务, 倾向\n[经] 责任, 义务, 负债

examples.en: These terms cover limits to liability and other terms and conditions.
In Canada, when hackers steal customers’ money, online banks disclaim liability.
I don't want to take on another liability.

liable.definition: s. subject to legal action\ns. (often followed by `to') likely to be affected with\ns. held legally responsible
liable.translation: a. 有义务的, 应负责的, 有...倾向的\n[法] 有责任的, 可受处理的, 应受罚的

examples.en: A newborn baby is liable to fall ill.
examples.zh: 新生婴儿很容易生病。

examples.en: We are all liable to make mistakes.
examples.zh: 我们都会犯错。

examples.en: You are liable for the debt.
examples.zh: 你有义务还债。

liberal.definition:
n. a person who favors a political philosophy of progress and reform and the protection of civil liberties
n. a person who favors an economic theory of laissez-faire and self-regulating markets
s. having political or social views favoring reform and progress
a. tolerant of change; not bound by authoritarianism, orthodoxy, or tradition
liberal.translation: n. 自由主义者\na. 慷慨的, 不拘泥的, 宽大的, 自由主义的

examples.en: There are two major political parties in the United States: the conservative Republican Party, and the liberal Democratic Party.
examples.zh: 美国有两大政党，一是较为保守的共和党，一是较为自由的民主党。

liberate.translation: vt. 解放, 释放, 使自由\n[机] 释出, 放出

examples.en: He liberated the people from bondage.
examples.zh: 他让人们摆脱了奴役。

liberty.definition: n. freedom of choice\nn. personal freedom from servitude or confinement or oppression
liberty.translation: n. 自由, 特权, 许可, 冒失\n[法] 自由, 自由权, 自由区域

examples.en: Liberty consists of being able to make everything as harmless as possible.
examples.zh: 自由旨在能够做所有不伤害其他人的事。

examples.en: The prisoner was set at liberty.
examples.zh: 囚犯重获自由。

examples.en: The essence of liberty is mathematics.
examples.zh: 自由的本质就是数学。

library.definition:
n. a room where books are kept
n. a collection of literary documents or records kept for reference or borrowing
n. a depository built to contain books and other materials for reading and study
n. (computing) a collection of standard programs and subroutines that are stored and available for immediate use
library.translation: n. 图书馆, 藏书, 库\n[计] 库

examples.en: I go to the library at least once a week.
examples.zh: 我每周至少去图书馆一次。

examples.en: Can you tell me how to get to the library?
examples.zh: 请问你能告诉我图书馆怎么走吗？

examples.en: He wants to go the library and get a spot.
examples.zh: 他要去图书馆占位。

license.definition:
n. a legal document giving official permission to do something
n. freedom to deviate deliberately from normally applicable rules or practices (especially in behavior or speech)
n. excessive freedom; lack of due restraint
n. the act of giving a formal (usually written) authorization
license.translation: n. 执照, 许可证, 特许\nvt. 许可, 特许

examples.en: Having a driver's license is an advantage for this job.
examples.zh: 有驾照者优先得到这个职位。

examples.en: My mother has a driver's license, but she doesn't drive.
examples.zh: 我母亲有驾照，但是她不开车。

examples.en: She isn't old enough to get a driving license.
examples.zh: 她没到拿驾照的年龄。

lid.definition: n. a movable top or cover (hinged or separate) for closing the opening at the top of a box, chest, jar, pan, etc.
lid.translation: n. 盖子, 限制, 眼睑\nvt. 给...盖盖子

examples.en: This jam jar's lid is stuck and won't open.
examples.zh: 这个果酱瓶的盖子卡住了，打不开。

examples.en: The date of manufacture is shown on the lid.
examples.zh: 生产日期在盖子上。

examples.en: The lid on this jam jar is stuck. It won't open.
examples.zh: 这个果酱瓶的盖子卡住了，打不开。

lie.definition:
n. a statement that deviates from or perverts the truth
n. Norwegian diplomat who was the first Secretary General of the United Nations (1896-1968)
n. position or manner in which something is situated
v. be located or situated somewhere; occupy a certain position
lie.translation: n. 谎言, 假象, 位置\nvi. 躺着, 说谎, 位于, 展现, 存在, 停泊\nvt. 谎骗

examples.en: Tom is too honest a boy to tell a lie.
examples.zh: 汤姆太老实了，连撒谎都不会。

examples.en: I know that I should not tell him a lie.
examples.zh: 我知道我不应该跟他说谎。

examples.en: People who will lie for you, will lie to you.
examples.zh: 会为你说谎的人，就会对你说谎。

life.definition:
n. a characteristic state or mode of living
n. the experience of being alive; the course of human events and activities
n. the course of existence of an individual; the actions and events that occur in living
n. the period during which something is functional (as between birth and death)
life.translation: n. 生活, 生命, 人生, 世事, 生物, 寿命, 一生, 生命力, 灵魂, 无期徒刑\n[医] 生活, 生存, 生命, 寿命

examples.en: That is one of my best time in my life.
examples.zh: 那是我一生中最美好的时光之一。

examples.en: He saved my life at the risk of his own.
examples.zh: 他冒著生命危险救了我的命。

examples.en: A car is a must for life in the suburbs.
examples.zh: 要住在郊区的话，汽车是必需的。

lifestyle.definition: n a manner of living that reflects the person's values and attitudes

examples.en: He has problems with adapting to lifestyle changes.
examples.zh: 他在适应新的生活方式上有问题。

lifetime.definition: n the period during which something is functional (as between birth and death)
lifetime.translation: n. 一生, 终生\na. 一生的, 终生的

examples.en: An opportunity like this only comes along once in a lifetime.
examples.zh: 一辈子只会出现一次像这样的机会。

examples.en: Communism will never be reached in my lifetime.
examples.zh: 在我有生之年，共产主义不可能达到。

examples.en: Some things I will never be able to learn in my lifetime.
examples.zh: 有些东西是我永远也学不会的。

lift.definition:
n. the act of giving temporary assistance
n. a wave that lifts the surface of the water or ground
n. a device worn in a shoe or boot to make the wearer look taller or to correct a shortened leg
n. one of the layers forming the heel of a shoe or boot
lift.translation: n. 举起, 帮助, 昂扬, 电梯\nvt. 升高, 提高, 鼓舞, 清偿, 空运, 举起, 剽窃\nvi. 升起, 消散, 耸立

examples.en: She tried to lift the box, but found it impossible.
examples.zh: 她试了试举起箱子，但举不起来。

examples.en: In case of fire, do not use the lift.
examples.zh: 如有火警，切勿使用升降机。

examples.en: Let me give you a lift as far as the station.
examples.zh: 让我送你到车站吧。

light.definition:
n. (physics) electromagnetic radiation that can produce a visual sensation
n. any device serving as a source of illumination
n. a particular perspective or aspect of a situation
n. an illuminated area
light.translation:
n. 光, 光亮, 灯, 日光, 发光体, 光源, 杰出人物, 火花, 眼光
a. 轻的, 少量的, 轻微的, 轻快的, 轻浮的, 明亮的, 淡色的, 容易的
vt. 点燃, 照亮
vi. 点着, 变亮, 突降, 偶然碰到
adv. 轻地

examples.en: The light is too dim for me to read easily.
examples.zh: 灯光太暗了，我没法阅读。

examples.en: I put the book down and turned on the light.
examples.zh: 我把书放下来然后开灯。

examples.en: He was bathed in the warmth of the kind light.
examples.zh: 亲切的灯光让他的身上充满了温暖的感觉。

like.definition:
n. a similar kind
n. a kind of person
v. find enjoyable or agreeable
v. be fond of
like.translation:
a. 相似的, 同样的
vt. 喜欢, 愿意, 想
vi. 喜欢, 希望
n. 爱好, 同样的人(或物)
prep. 象, 如同
adv. 可能

examples.en: A cold wave of fear hit me like a brick.
examples.zh: 一阵寒意像砖头一样击中了我。

examples.en: Would you like to go see a movie with me?
examples.zh: 不如一起去看电影吧。

examples.en: What do you like to do in your free time?
examples.zh: 您空闲时间喜欢做什么？

likelihood.definition: n. the probability of a specified outcome

examples.en: In all likelihood, this means war.
examples.zh: 这很可能意味着战争。

likely.definition: a. has a good chance of being the case or of coming about\ns. expected to become or be; in prospect\ns. within the realm of credibility
likely.translation: a. 有可能的, 合适的, 前途有望的\nadv. 或许, 可能

examples.en: "Tom is likely to be late." "I think so, too."
examples.zh: “汤姆应该会迟到。” “我同意。”

examples.en: You ought to tell Tom that you'll likely be late.
examples.zh: 你应该告诉汤姆你可能会迟到。

examples.en: Mary isn't likely to be hungry when she gets here.
examples.zh: 玛莉到这里时应该不会饿。

likewise.definition: r in like or similar manner\nr in addition\nr equally

examples.en: Tom is tall and likewise strong.
examples.zh: 汤姆又高又壮。

examples.en: "I hate you!" "Likewise."
examples.zh: “我讨厌你！”“彼此彼此。”

limb.definition:
n. one of the jointed appendages of an animal used for locomotion or grasping: arm; leg; wing; flipper
n. any of the main branches arising from the trunk or a bough of a tree
n. (astronomy) the circumferential edge of the apparent disc of the sun or the moon or a planet
n. either of the two halves of a bow from handle to tip
limb.translation: n. 四肢, 枝干, 翼, 边缘\nvt. 切断...之手足

examples.en: Tom hung the lamp on the limb of a tree.
Tom was killed when a tree limb fell on him.
In this tree, there is an apple on every limb.

limit.definition:
n. the greatest possible degree of something
n. as far as something can go
n. the boundary of a specific area
n. the mathematical value toward which a function goes as the independent variable approaches infinity
limit.translation: n. 界限, 边界, 限度, 极限, 限制\nvt. 限制, 限定

examples.en: How can a router be used to limit network speed?
examples.zh: 怎么用路由器限制网速？

examples.en: Limit the consumption of white sugar and salt.
examples.zh: 限制白糖和盐的摄取量。

examples.en: The car is exceeding the speed limit.
examples.zh: 这辆车超速了。

limitation.definition: n. the quality of being limited or restricted\nn. (law) a time period after which suits cannot be brought\nn. an act of limiting or restricting (as by regulation)
limitation.translation: n. 限制, 缺陷, 限额\n[医] 限界, 限制, 限度

examples.en: Tom is aware of his own limitations.
examples.zh: 汤姆清楚自己的局限。

examples.en: I know my limitations.
examples.zh: 我知道我的限度。

examples.en: Gestural language had, however, serious limitations, since it could not be used in the dark or at distance.
examples.zh: 可是，手语也绝对不是万能的，当四周太暗，或者距离太远的时候，它就完全派不上用场。

limp.definition:
v. walk impeded by some physical limitation or injury
v. proceed slowly or with difficulty
s. not firm
s. lacking in strength or firmness or resilience
limp.translation: n. 跛行\na. 柔软的, 无力的, 软弱的\nvi. 跛行

examples.en: Her coloring book lay limp, jagged with angular pink scribbles.
She has sagging tits and her husband has a limp noodle.
The paramedics loaded Tom's limp body onto a stretcher.

line.definition:
n. a formation of people or things one beside another
n. a mark that is long relative to its width
n. a formation of people or things one behind another
n. a length (straight or curved) without breadth or thickness; the trace of a moving point
line.translation:
n. 列, 线, 绳, 电线, 线路, 路线, 航线, 作业线, 界线, 战线, 外形, 排, 家系
vt. 排成一行, 顺...排列, 划线于, 加衬里, 使有线条, 使起皱纹
vi. 排队
[计] 线路

examples.en: Drop me a line as soon as you get there.
examples.zh: 到了那儿之后跟我说一声儿。

examples.en: Do you know how to use these command line tools?
examples.zh: 你知道怎样使用这些命令行工具吗？

examples.en: Excuse me, which subway line is to the city centre?
examples.zh: 抱歉，地铁几号线去市中心？

linear.definition:
a. designating or involving an equation whose terms are of the first degree
a. of or in or along or relating to a line; involving a single dimension
s. (of a leaf shape) long and narrow
s. measured lengthwise
linear.translation: a. 线的, 直线的, 线状的\n[计] 线性

examples.en: Is the system linear?
examples.zh: 系统是线性的吗？

linen.definition: n. a fabric woven with fibers from the flax plant\nn. a high-quality paper made of linen fibers or with a linen finish\nn. white goods or clothing made with linen cloth
linen.translation: n. 亚麻布, 亚麻线, 亚麻制品\na. 亚麻布制的, 亚麻的

examples.en: I want to buy new bed linen.
examples.zh: 我想买一个新床单。

linger.definition: v. remain present although waning or gradually dying\nv. take one's time; proceed slowly
linger.translation: vi. 逗留, 消磨, 徘徊\nvt. 消磨

examples.en: There are rumors that some evil spirits linger around here.
examples.zh: 传闻这附近有些脏东西。

examples.en: What are you lingering for? Hurry up and go.
examples.zh: 你磨蹭什么呀，快点去吧。

examples.en: A cloud of dust and debris rose and lingered in the sky for a few minutes afterward.
examples.zh: 一团尘土与瓦砾腾空而起，在空中盘旋了数分钟。

link.definition:
n. the means of connection between things linked in series
n. a fastener that serves to join or connect
n. a unit of length equal to 1/100 of a chain
n. (computing) an instruction that connects one part of a program or an element on a list to another program or list
link.translation:
n. 环, 连结物, 链接, 火把
vt. 连结, 联合, 挽住
vi. 连接起来
[计] 连接, 链路

examples.en: Did you mean to link me that?
examples.zh: 你是想将我与其联系起来吗？

examples.en: Don't click on that link.
examples.zh: 不要点击那个链接。

examples.en: Trams will link the area to Edinburgh's city centre (which is only two miles away).
examples.zh: 电车会把这个地区连接于爱丁堡的城市中心（离那里只有两英里）。

lion.definition: n. large gregarious predatory feline of Africa and India having a tawny coat with a shaggy mane in the male\nn. a celebrity who is lionized (much sought after)
lion.translation: n. 狮子, 狮子(星)座, 国际狮子会会员

examples.en: A giraffe can kill a lion with a single kick.
examples.zh: 长颈鹿一脚可以踢死狮子。

examples.en: Have you seen the movie "Lion of The Desert"?
examples.zh: 你看过《沙漠雄狮》吗？

examples.en: The lion is the king of the jungle.
examples.zh: 狮子是丛林之王。

lip.definition: n. either of two fleshy folds of tissue that surround the mouth and play a role in speaking\nn. (botany) either of the two parts of a bilabiate corolla or calyx\nn. either the outer margin or the inner margin of the aperture of a gastropod's shell
lip.translation:
n. 唇, 口缘, 唇状构造
vt. 以嘴唇碰, 轻轻说出
a. 口头上的
[计] 大型互连网信息包

examples.en: Your lips are soft like the surface of a cactus.
examples.zh: 你的嘴唇软绵绵的，就像仙人掌的表皮一样。

examples.en: She pressed her lips together and willed herself not to cry.
examples.zh: 她合上双唇，并告诉自己不要哭。

examples.en: In a horrifying chain of events, Christopher Columbus once bit his own lip.
examples.zh: 在一连串可怕的事件中, 哥伦布曾经咬紧牙关撑过去。

liquid.definition:
n. a substance that is liquid at room temperature and pressure
n. the state in which a substance exhibits a characteristic readiness to flow with little or no tendency to disperse and relatively high incompressibility
n. fluid matter having no fixed shape but a fixed volume
n. a frictionless continuant that is not a nasal consonant (especially `l' and `r')
liquid.translation: n. 液体, 流体, 流音\na. 液体的, 透明的, 明亮的, 流动的, 易变的

examples.en: Water is liquid. When it freezes, it becomes solid.
examples.zh: 水是液体。冻起来就成了固体。

examples.en: I don't like to use liquid laundry detergent.
examples.zh: 我不喜欢用洗衣液。

examples.en: You should drink a lot of liquid.
examples.zh: 你应该喝大量的液体。

list.definition:
n. a database containing an ordered array of items (names or topics)
v. give or make a list of; name individually; give the names of
v. include in a list
v. cause to lean to the side
list.translation:
n. 目录, 名单, 明细表, 布条, 条纹, 列表, 序列, 数据清单
vt. 列出, 列于表上, 记入名单内, 装布条
vi. 列于表上
[计] 列表, 序列, 数据清单

examples.en: I wonder why they left my name off the list.
examples.zh: 我奇怪他们为什么在表里把我的名字落下了。

examples.en: Tom made a list of places he wants to visit.
examples.zh: 汤姆把他想去的地方列成了一张清单。

examples.en: Tom made a list of places he wanted to visit.
examples.zh: 汤姆列了他想去的地方的名单。

listen.definition: v. hear with intention\nv. listen and pay attention
listen.translation: vi. 听, 倾听, 听从\nn. 听, 倾听

examples.en: Do you listen to the radio at home every day?
examples.zh: 你每天都在家听收音机吗？

examples.en: Will you put down that paper and listen to me?
examples.zh: 你能放下报纸听我说吗？

examples.en: Do you ever listen to English programs on the air?
examples.zh: 你曾经听过英语广播节目吗?

literacy.definition: n. the ability to read and write
literacy.translation: n. 读写能力, 识字, 精通文学

examples.en: Secondly, the literacy rate in Europe of that time was low.
Before widespread literacy, history was written by the winners.
Many new teachers feel ill-prepared to teach basic literacy and numeracy.

literal.definition: s. without interpretation or embellishment\na. limited to the explicit meaning of a word or text\ns. avoiding embellishment or exaggeration (used for emphasis)
literal.translation: a. 逐字的, 字面上的, 文字的, 字母的\nn. 印刷错误\n[计] 文字; 直接量; 字面量; 句节

examples.en: He explained the literal meaning of the sentence.
examples.zh: 他解释了句子的字面意思。

examples.en: He explained the literal meaning of the sentences.
examples.zh: 他解释了句子的字面意思。

examples.en: Your interpretation is a bit too literal.
examples.zh: 你的理解有点望文生义了。

literary.definition: a. of or relating to or characteristic of literature\ns. knowledgeable about literature\ns. appropriate to literature rather than everyday speech or writing
literary.translation: a. 文学的, 文艺的, 精通文学的\n[法] 文学的, 从事文学的, 从事写作的

examples.en: Prominent figures in the literary world gathered together last night.
examples.zh: 知名文学界人士昨晚齐聚一堂。

examples.en: Well-known figures from the literary world gathered together last night.
examples.zh: 知名文学界人士昨晚齐聚一堂。

examples.en: Noted literary personalities gathered together last evening.
examples.zh: 知名文学界人士昨晚齐聚一堂。

literature.definition:
n. creative writing of recognized artistic value
n. the humanistic study of a body of literature
n. published writings in a particular style on a particular subject
n. the profession or art of a writer
literature.translation: n. 文学, 文艺, 著作\n[经] 广告, 商品介绍等文学

examples.en: You should memorize a piece of classical literature every day.
examples.zh: 你必须每天背一篇古典文献。

examples.en: He is already skilled in both math and literature.
examples.zh: 他既精于数学又精于文学。

examples.en: He went to America for the purpose of studying American literature.
examples.zh: 他去了美国读美国文学。

litter.definition:
n. the offspring at one birth of a multiparous mammal
n. rubbish carelessly dropped or left about (especially in public places)
n. conveyance consisting of a chair or bed carried on two poles by bearers
v. strew
litter.translation: n. 垃圾, 杂乱, 轿, 担架\nvt. 乱丢, 铺草, 弄乱\nvi. 产仔, 乱丢垃圾

examples.en: A lot of people climb the railing, and even litter.
examples.zh: 很多人跳过栏杆，还丢垃圾。

little.definition:
n. a small amount or duration
a. (quantifier used with mass nouns) small in quantity or degree; not much or almost none or (with `a') at least some
s. (of children and animals) young, immature
s. (of a voice) faint
little.translation: n. 一点点, 少许, 一会儿, 短时间\na. 小的, 很少的, 幼小的, 琐碎的, 短暂的, 矮小的\nadv. 很少, 稍微, 完全不

examples.en: But, I don't eat even a little bit of meat.
examples.zh: 但是，我一点儿肉也不吃。

examples.en: I admit, at that time I was a little drunk.
examples.zh: 我承认当时是有点醉。

examples.en: It seems to me that she is a little selfish.
examples.zh: 我觉得她有点自私。

live.definition:
v. lead a certain kind of life; live in a certain style
v. pursue a positive and satisfying existence
a. actually being performed at the time of hearing or viewing
a. exerting force or containing energy
live.translation:
a. 活的, 生动的, 精力充沛的, 实况转播的
vi. 活, 生存, 居住
vt. 过着, 度过, 经历
adv. 实况地

examples.en: We saw a lot of live fish in the pond.
examples.zh: 我们看见池里有很多活鱼。

examples.en: The moon is not a good place to live on.
examples.zh: 月球不是一个适合居住的地方。

examples.en: I live on a farm not too far from Boston.
examples.zh: 我住在离波士顿不远的一个农场。

lively.definition: a. full of life and energy\ns. full of zest or vigor\ns. filled with events or activity
lively.translation: a. 活泼的, 鲜明的, 生动的

examples.en: There isn't a place in this market that isn't lively.
examples.zh: 市场上到处都很热闹。

examples.en: The atmosphere is always extremely lively when eating hot pot.
examples.zh: 吃火锅的时候 ,气氛往往是非常热闹的.

examples.en: This village isn't big, but it's quite lively.
examples.zh: 这个小镇不大,可是很热闹.

liver.definition:
n. large and complicated reddish-brown glandular organ located in the upper right portion of the abdominal cavity; secretes bile and functions in metabolism of protein and carbohydrate and fat; synthesizes substances involved in the clotting of the blood; synthesizes vitamin A; detoxifies poisonous substances and breaks down worn-out erythrocytes
n. liver of an animal used as meat
n. a person who has a special life style
n. someone who lives in a place
liver.translation: n. 肝脏, 生活者, 居民\n[医] 肝

examples.en: I have a corner in my liver just for you, alcohol.
examples.zh: 我在肝里给你留了个地方，酒精啊。

livestock.definition: n. any animals kept for use or profit
livestock.translation: n. 家畜\n[经] 牲畜, 家畜

examples.en: Iran has a large livestock industry, including sheep and cattle.
Some Tuaregs rely completely on their livestock for their survival.
The inhabitants apparently all benefited from agricultural and livestock farming.

living.definition:
n. people who are still living
a. pertaining to living persons
s. true to life; lifelike
s. (informal) absolute
living.translation: n. 生活, 生计, 生存\na. 活的, 逼真的, 现存的

examples.en: The living room in my new house is very large.
examples.zh: 我新家的客厅很宽敞。

examples.en: Tom is in the living room, sleeping on the couch.
examples.zh: 汤姆在客厅长沙发上睡觉。

examples.en: The living room in my new house is very spacious.
examples.zh: 我新家的客厅很宽敞。

load.definition:
n. weight to be borne or conveyed
n. a quantity that can be processed or transported at one time
n. an amount of alcohol sufficient to intoxicate
n. the power output of a generator or power plant
load.translation:
n. 负荷, 担子, 重担, 装载量, 负载, 工作量, 加载
vt. 装载, 装填, 使担负
vi. 装货, 上客, 装料
[计] 加载, 装入程序

examples.en: The load of the truck was in excess of three tons.
examples.zh: 货车的载货量超过了三吨。

examples.en: This truck has a maximum load of 5 tons.
examples.zh: 这辆卡车最大的载重量是5吨。

examples.en: The man is loading the moving truck on his own.
examples.zh: 这个男人独自把东西搬上搬家卡车上。

loan.definition: n. the temporary provision of money (usually at interest)
loan.translation: n. 贷款, 借出\nv. 借, 供应货款, 借给

examples.en: I told Tom I'd be willing to loan him some money.
examples.zh: 我告诉汤姆我愿意借给他一些钱。

examples.en: You can get a loan from a bank.
examples.zh: 你可以从银行贷款。

examples.en: Tom asked Mary to loan him some money.
examples.zh: 汤姆问玛丽她能不能借些钱给他。

lobby.definition: n. the people who support some common cause or business or principle or sectional interest\nn. a group of people who try actively to influence legislation\nv. detain in conversation by or as if by holding on to the outer garments of; as for political or economic favors
lobby.translation: n. 大厅, 休息室, 游说议员者\nvi. 游说议员, 游说\nvt. 游说

examples.en: I have a friend waiting for me in the lobby.
examples.zh: 有个朋友正在大堂等我。

examples.en: Meet me at the lobby of the Imperial Hotel at 6:30 p.m.
examples.zh: 下午六点半到帝国酒店的大堂找我。

local.definition:
n. public transport consisting of a bus or train that stops at all stations or stops
a. relating to or applicable to or concerned with the administration of a city or town or district rather than a larger area
a. of or belonging to or characteristic of a particular locality or neighborhood
a. affecting only a restricted part or area of the body
local.translation: a. 地方性的, 当地的, 局部的, 乡土的, 本地的\nn. 当地居民, 本地新闻, 局部\n[计] 本地的; 局部

examples.en: Many local traditions have fallen into decay in recent years.
examples.zh: 近几年，很多当地的传统都衰败了。

examples.en: This newspaper is well known in the local area.
examples.zh: 这家报社在当地知名度颇高。

examples.en: Local businesses are teaming up for a charity initiative.
examples.zh: 当地企业正在联手举办一项慈善活动。

locate.definition: v. discover the location of; determine the place of; find by searching or examining\nv. assign a location to
locate.translation: vt. 找出, 设于, 位于\nvi. 定居

examples.en: I can't locate the source of the problem.
examples.zh: 我无法找到问题的根源。

examples.en: The bus stop is located right outside where I live.
examples.zh: 公共汽车的停车站正好坐落在我的住所前面。

examples.en: Norway, located in Northern Europe, is a highly developed country.
examples.zh: 挪威位于北欧，是个高度发展的国家。

location.definition: n. a point or extent in space\nn. a workplace away from a studio at which some or all of a movie may be made
location.translation: n. 位置, 场所, 特定区域\n[计] 位置

examples.en: A GPS device can pinpoint your location anywhere in the world.
examples.zh: 无论你在世界的哪一个角落，你都可以使用全球定位仪来找出你的所在。

examples.en: A bookstore in that location wouldn't make enough money to survive.
examples.zh: 那个地点的书店无法赚足够的钱生存下去。

examples.en: I suggest we move to a safer location.
examples.zh: 我建议我们去个更安全的地方。

lock.definition:
n. a fastener fitted to a door or drawer to keep it firmly closed
n. a strand or cluster of hair
n. a mechanism that detonates the charge of a gun
n. enclosure consisting of a section of canal that can be closed to control the water level; used to raise or lower vessels that pass through it
lock.translation: n. 锁, 刹车, 水闸, 一缕头发\nvt. 锁, 锁上, 拘禁, 隐藏, (用锁等)拴住, 刹住\nvi. 锁住, (齿轮等)啮合, (船)过闸

examples.en: Make sure to lock the door before going to bed.
examples.zh: 上床睡觉前请一定要锁好门。

examples.en: Tom suggested that I change the lock on my door.
examples.zh: 汤姆建议我换我的门锁。

examples.en: When I opened the door, I broke the lock.
examples.zh: 我开门的时候弄坏了锁。

locomotive.definition: n. a wheeled vehicle consisting of a self-propelled engine that is used to draw trains along railway tracks\na. of or relating to locomotion
locomotive.translation: n. 火车头, 机车\na. 运转的, 火车头的, 移动的

examples.en: The locomotive was pulling a long line of freight cars.
Today, the locomotive is pushing the cars in the train.
The locomotive was pulling a long line of goods wagons.

lodge.definition:
n. English physicist who studied electromagnetic radiation and was a pioneer of radiotelegraphy (1851-1940)
n. small house at the entrance to the grounds of a country mansion; usually occupied by a gatekeeper or gardener
n. a small (rustic) house used as a temporary shelter
n. any of various Native American dwellings
lodge.translation: n. 小屋, 门房, 支部, 旅舍, 分会\nvi. 临时住宿, 倒伏, 寄宿, 投宿\nvt. 安顿, 容纳, 提出, 把...射入, 存放

examples.en: Tom stayed in the ski lodge while Mary went skiing.
They will lodge by twos and threes in lonely farmhouses.
You'll be staying with me at a luxurious lodge.

log.definition:
n. a segment of the trunk of a tree when stripped of branches
n. a written record of messages sent or received
n. a written record of events on a voyage (of a ship or plane)
n. measuring instrument that consists of a float that trails from a ship by a knotted line in order to measure the ship's speed through the water
log.translation:
n. 记录, 圆木, 日志, 计程仪
vt. 伐木, 切, 航行
vi. 伐木
[计] 日志

examples.en: You need a password to log in again after logging out.
examples.zh: 登出后重新登入需要密码。

examples.en: I log in to Tatoeba once a week.
examples.zh: 我每周登录 tatoeba 一次。

examples.en: The writer is living in a log cabin.
examples.zh: 那个作家生活在小木屋中。

logic.definition:
n. the branch of philosophy that analyzes inference
n. reasoned and reasonable judgment
n. the principles that guide reasoning within a given field or situation
n. the system of operations performed by a computer that underlies the machine's representation of logical operations
logic.translation: n. 逻辑, 逻辑学, 推理的方法, 推理, 逻辑性\n[计] 逻辑

examples.en: Mathematics is like the logic of physics.
examples.zh: 数学就像物理的逻辑一样。

examples.en: Do you not understand basic logic?
examples.zh: 你不懂基本逻辑吗？

examples.en: I can't find any logic to English spelling. “Ghoti” can be pronounced as “fish.”
examples.zh: 我找不到任何英文拼写的逻辑。"Ghoti" 可以被发音成"fish"。

logical.definition: a. capable of or reflecting the capability for correct and valid reasoning
logical.translation: a. 合乎逻辑的, 合理的\n[法] 逻辑的, 符合逻辑的

examples.en: The most logical place to keep your shoes is near the door.
examples.zh: 最合逻辑的放鞋处是门口附近。

examples.en: This seems logical to me.
examples.zh: 我觉得很有逻辑。

examples.en: What you're saying isn't logical.
examples.zh: 你说的话在逻辑上有问题。

lonely.definition: s. marked by dejection from being alone\ns. devoid of creatures
lonely.translation: a. 孤单的, 孤寂的, 荒凉的

examples.en: When I don't have my cell phone, I feel lonely.
examples.zh: 我没有我的手机的时候会感到很孤独。

examples.en: I know that you don't want to be lonely.
examples.zh: 我知道你不想一个人呆著。

examples.en: I wonder why I feel so lonely when it gets cold.
examples.zh: 我很疑惑为什么天气变冷的时候我会觉得很孤单。

long.definition:
a. primarily temporal sense; being or indicating a relatively great or greater than average duration or passage of time or a duration as specified
a. primarily spatial sense; of relatively great or greater than average spatial extension or extension as specified
s. of relatively great height
a. holding securities or commodities in expectation of a rise in prices
long.translation:
a. 长的, 长久的, 冗长的, 做多头的
vi. 渴望, 热望, 极想
adv. 长久, 始终
n. 长时间, 长信号, 长整型
[计] 长, 长整型

examples.en: It took her a long time to choose a hat.
examples.zh: 她花了好长时间挑帽子。

examples.en: Sorry it took me so long to write to you.
examples.zh: 对不起, 我过了这么长的时间才回你的信。

examples.en: You can stay here as long as you want to.
examples.zh: 你愿意在这里呆多久就呆多久。

look.definition:
n. the act of directing the eyes toward something and perceiving it visually
n. physical appearance
v. perceive with attention; direct one's gaze towards
v. give a certain impression or have a certain outward aspect
look.translation: n. 一看, 神色, 样子, 面容\nvi. 看, 注意, 朝着, 显得\nvt. 打量, 看上去与...一样, 以眼色(或脸色)显示, 期待

examples.en: I was too shy to look her in the face.
examples.zh: 我害羞得不敢正面看她的脸。

examples.en: I look on watching TV as a waste of time.
examples.zh: 我觉得看电视很浪费时间。

examples.en: I need to have a quick look at the files.
examples.zh: 我需要去查一下档案。

loom.definition:
n. a textile machine for weaving yarn into a textile
v. come into view indistinctly, often threateningly
v. appear very large or occupy a commanding position
v. weave on a loom
loom.translation: n. 织布机, 若隐若现的景象\nvi. 朦胧地出现, 隐约可见, 可怕地出现

examples.en: Few people weave their own fabric on a loom these days.
Many good grades will loom on the horizon.
In Ukraine, the threat of a global nuclear disaster looms.

loop.definition:
n. anything with a round or oval shape (formed by a curve that is closed and does not intersect itself)
n. an inner circle of advisors (especially under President Reagan)
n. the basic pattern of the human fingerprint
n. a computer program that performs a series of instructions repeatedly until some specified condition is satisfied
loop.translation:
n. 环, 圈, 弯曲部分, 循环
vt. 使成环, 以圈结, 以环连结
vi. 打环, 翻筋斗
[计] 循环

examples.en: I listened to that song on loop all day yesterday.
The music is being played in an endless loop.
The piece of music is being played in an endless loop.

loose.definition:
a. not compact or dense in structure or arrangement
s. (of a ball in sport) not in the possession or control of any player
a. not tight; not closely constrained or constricted or constricting
s. not tense or taut
loose.translation:
n. 发射, 放任, 放纵
a. 宽松的, 松的, 宽的, 不牢固的, 散漫的, 自由的, 不精确的
vt. 释放, 放枪, 开船
vi. 变松, 开火
adv. 松散地

examples.en: No money, no job, no friends. He was truly at loose ends.
examples.zh: 没钱，没工作，没朋友，他真是无所适从。

examples.en: The original qipao was wide and loose.
examples.zh: 最初的旗袍是宽松的。

examples.en: She wore a long, loose coat.
examples.zh: 她穿了一件宽松的长外套。

lord.definition: n. a titled peer of the realm\nv. make a lord of someone
lord.translation: n. 统治者, 阁下, 上帝\nvi. 称王, 作威作福\nvt. 使成贵族

examples.en: The lord held absolute power over his subjects.
examples.zh: 领主对他的臣民有绝对权力。

examples.en: My Lord I lose the game.
examples.zh: 是在下输了。

examples.en: The demon lord finally lost consciousness and fell to the floor with a thud.
examples.zh: 大魔王终于失去知觉，砰的一声倒在了地上。

lose.definition:
v. fail to keep or to maintain; cease to have, either physically or in an abstract sense
v. fail to win
v. suffer the loss of a person through death or removal
v. miss from one's possessions; lose sight of
lose.translation: vt. 遗失, 损失, 丢失, 使失去, 错过, 浪费, 迷失, 使迷路, 输去, 使沉溺于\nvi. 受损失, 失败

examples.en: Tom and Mary say that they want to lose weight.
examples.zh: 汤姆跟玛丽说他们想减肥。

examples.en: A student should not lose sight of his own identity.
examples.zh: 学生不该忽略自己的身份。

examples.en: He would rather lose his life than betray his organization.
examples.zh: 他宁可牺牲生命，也不出卖组织。

loss.definition:
n. something that is lost
n. gradual decline in amount or activity
n. the act of losing someone or something
n. the disadvantage that results from losing something
loss.translation: n. 损失, 遗失, 失败, 输, 错过, 伤亡\n[化] 损失; 损耗

examples.en: I was at a loss as to what to say.
examples.zh: 我无话可说。

examples.en: Mary is at a loss what to say to him.
examples.zh: 玛莉不知道该和他说甚么才好。

examples.en: The loss of his mother brought him sorrow and regret.
examples.zh: 他母亲的离世带给他悲伤和遗憾。

lot.definition: n. a parcel of land having fixed boundaries\nn. (Old Testament) nephew of Abraham; God destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah but chose to spare Lot and his family who were told to flee without looking back at the destruction\nv. divide into lots, as of land, for example
lot.translation: n. 运气, 签, 抽签, 份额, 许多, 一堆\nvt. 划分\nvi. 抽签, 抓阄

examples.en: It is a lot of fun to drive a car.
examples.zh: 开车很好玩。

examples.en: You can see a lot of stars in the sky.
examples.zh: 你能看到天空中的繁星。

examples.en: We saw a lot of live fish in the pond.
examples.zh: 我们看见池里有很多活鱼。

lottery.definition: n. something that is regarded as a chance event\nn. players buy (or are given) chances and prizes are distributed by casting lots
lottery.translation: n. 奖券, 彩票, 运气\n[经] 抽彩给奖法

examples.en: If I won the lottery, I'd buy a new car.
examples.zh: 如果我中了彩票，我会买辆新车。

examples.en: Finding a decent man is more difficult than winning a lottery.
examples.zh: 找一个好男人比中彩票还要难。

examples.en: Do you still buy lottery tickets?
examples.zh: 你还买彩票吗？

loud.definition: a. characterized by or producing sound of great volume or intensity
loud.translation: a. 大声的, 不断的, 喧吵的\nadv. 高声地, 大声地

examples.en: He was roused by a loud knocking at the door.
examples.zh: 他被啪啪的敲门声吵醒了。

examples.en: Tom was trying hard not to laugh out loud.
examples.zh: 汤姆拼命地忍住笑声。

examples.en: My father always speaks in a very loud voice.
examples.zh: 我父亲总是说话很大声。

love.definition:
n. a strong positive emotion of regard and affection
n. any object of warm affection or devotion; 
n. a deep feeling of sexual desire and attraction
n. a score of zero in tennis or squash
love.translation: n. 爱, 恋爱, 爱情, 爱好, 性爱\nvt. 爱, 爱好, 爱慕\nvi. 爱

examples.en: I love her so much that I can't leave her.
examples.zh: 我如此地爱她所以我无法离开她。

examples.en: I don't love her, not even if she loves me.
examples.zh: 即使她爱我，我也不爱她。

examples.en: Tom doesn't love you as much as I love you.
examples.zh: 汤没我爱你。

lovely.definition: s. appealing to the emotions as well as the eye
lovely.translation: a. 可爱的, 有趣的

examples.en: There are four lovely children in this photo.
examples.zh: 这张照片上有四个可爱的孩子。

examples.en: Look at that lovely house of Mary's.
examples.zh: 看看玛丽那漂亮的房子。

examples.en: My wife's 34 and she's a lovely person.
examples.zh: 我妻子34岁了，她是个可爱的人。

low.definition:
n. an air mass of lower pressure; often brings precipitation
n. British political cartoonist (born in New Zealand) who created the character Colonel Blimp (1891-1963)
n. a low level or position or degree
a. less than normal in degree or intensity or amount
low.translation:
n. 低点, 低价, 低, 牛叫声
a. 低的, 消沉的, 低等的, 浅的, 卑贱的
adv. 低下地, 谦卑地, 低
vi. 牛叫

examples.en: Because his salary is low, he can't buy that house.
examples.zh: 因为他的薪水太低，他买不起那栋房子。

examples.en: The shower head in this shower is too low.
examples.zh: 这个淋浴的莲蓬头太低了。

examples.en: I bought a VCR at that store for a low price.
examples.zh: 我在那商店花低价买了台录像机。

lower.definition: v. move something or somebody to a lower position\nv. set lower\nv. cause to drop or sink
lower.translation: a. 低的, 下级的, 下层的\nvi. 降低, 跌落, 减弱\nvt. 放下, 降下, 减弱, 贬低

examples.en: When the pressure is lower, the boiling point is lower.
examples.zh: 压力越低，沸点越低。

examples.en: The Alps are generally lower on the Italian side.
examples.zh: 阿尔卑斯山脉义大利一侧的海拔通常较低。

examples.en: The government clearly stated its intention to lower taxes.
examples.zh: 政府明确宣布了降税的意图。

loyal.definition: a. steadfast in allegiance or duty
loyal.translation: a. 忠诚的, 忠实的, 忠贞的

examples.en: To whom are you loyal: me or the king?
examples.zh: 你忠于我还是国王？

loyalty.definition: n. the quality of being loyal\nn. feelings of allegiance
loyalty.translation: n. 忠贞, 忠诚, 忠实\n[法] 忠诚, 忠心

examples.en: Sami paid for his loyalty to Layla with his life.
The dictator had the absolute loyalty of all his aides.
The dictator had the absolute loyalty of all his assistants.

lubricate.definition: v. have lubricating properties\nv. apply a lubricant to\nv. make slippery or smooth through the application of a lubricant
lubricate.translation: vt. 使润滑, 涂油\nvi. 润滑

examples.en: A cat licks itself to lubricate its skin and fur.
I need to lubricate the hinges on that door.
Before putting the cables in, I lubricate the tube.

luck.definition: n. an unknown and unpredictable phenomenon that causes an event to result one way rather than another\nn. an unknown and unpredictable phenomenon that leads to a favorable outcome
luck.translation: n. 运气, 幸运, 好运, 侥幸\nvi. 靠好运成功

examples.en: We wish you the best of luck in your endeavors.
examples.zh: 祝您一切顺利。

examples.en: I don't believe that black cats cause bad luck.
examples.zh: 我不相信黑猫与厄运有关系。

examples.en: A little bit of luck sometimes leads to an unexpected success.
examples.zh: 一点点的运气有时会导致意想不到的成功。

lucky.definition: s. occurring by chance\na. having or bringing good fortune
lucky.translation: a. 幸运的, 吉祥的, 好运的, 侥幸的

examples.en: I can produce several pieces a day if I'm lucky.
examples.zh: 如果运气好的话，我一天可以生产好几件。

examples.en: It was lucky for you that you found it.
examples.zh: 你很幸运找到了它。

examples.en: This year has been a lucky one for him.
examples.zh: 这年对他来说是幸运的一年。

luggage.definition: n cases used to carry belongings when traveling

examples.en: Bob, help me carry his luggage to the living room.
examples.zh: Bob，帮我把他的行李搬到客厅。

examples.en: We loaded a lot of luggage into the car.
examples.zh: 我们往车里装了很多行李。

examples.en: The luggage is piled up in the truck.
examples.zh: 行李堆放在卡车里。

lumber.definition: n. the wood of trees cut and prepared for use as building material\nv. move heavily or clumsily
lumber.translation: n. 木材, 破旧家俱, 废物, 隆隆声\nvt. 砍伐木材, 乱堆\nvi. 笨拙地移动, 喧闹地向前走, 隆隆地移动

examples.en: We are currently lacking good quality building lumber.
examples.zh: 现在正缺良好的建筑木材。

examples.en: They will send us lumber.
examples.zh: 他们要发送木材给我们。

lump.translation: n. 块, 瘤, 很多, 肿块, 笨人\nvt. 使成块状, 混在一起\nvi. 结块

examples.en: I bumped my head against the door and got a lump.
examples.zh: 我头撞到了门，肿了一块。

examples.en: That boy threw a lump of rock.
examples.zh: 那个男孩抛了一块石头。

examples.en: He is a lump of selfishness.
examples.zh: 他是个极其自私自利的人。

lunar.definition: a. of or relating to or associated with the moon
lunar.translation: a. 阴历的, 月的, 微亮的(指光)\n[医] 月的, 银的

examples.en: In China, they celebrate New Year by the lunar calendar.
examples.zh: 中国按阴历过新年。

examples.en: 2010 was the Year of the Tiger in the Chinese lunar calendar.
examples.zh: 2010年是农历的虎年。

examples.en: Did you see yesterday's total lunar eclipse?
examples.zh: 你看到昨天的日全食了吗？

lunch.definition: n. a midday meal\nv. take the midday meal\nv. provide a midday meal for

examples.en: After she had lunch, she got ready to go out.
examples.zh: 吃过午饭后，她准备好要出门了。

examples.en: Tom always feels hungry at least one hour before lunch.
examples.zh: 汤姆总是在离午餐至少还要一个小时之前就饿了。

examples.en: I ate lunch two and a half hours ago.
examples.zh: 我在两个半小时以前就吃了午饭。

lung.definition: n. either of two saclike respiratory organs in the chest of vertebrates; serves to remove carbon dioxide and provide oxygen to the blood
lung.translation: n. 肺, 肺脏, 空地\n[医] 肺

examples.en: That man died of lung cancer a week ago.
examples.zh: 那个男人在一周前死于肺癌。

examples.en: Parks are for the city what lungs are for animals.
examples.zh: 公园和城市的关系，就好比肺和动物的关系一样。

examples.en: Smokers are far more likely to develop lung cancer than non-smokers are.
examples.zh: 吸烟的人患上肺癌的风险比不吸烟的人高得多。

lure.definition: n. qualities that attract by seeming to promise some kind of reward
lure.translation: n. 饵, 诱惑\nvt. 引诱, 诱惑

examples.en: No man can resist the lure of a woman.
examples.zh: 没有男人能够抵挡女人的诱惑。

lurk.definition: v. lie in wait, lie in ambush, behave in a sneaky and secretive manner
lurk.translation: n. 潜伏, 潜行\nvi. 暗藏, 潜伏, 埋伏\n[计] 隐匿阅读

examples.en: Solve the mystery lurking behind the murder!
examples.zh: 要解开谋杀背后潜藏之谜！

examples.en: What is lurking in the shadows?
examples.zh: 谁在影子里藏著？

lush.translation: a. 苍翠繁茂的, 多青草的, 丰富的\nn. 酒, 酒鬼\nv. 饮

examples.en: He's a lush.
examples.zh: 他是个酒鬼。

examples.en: On a clear October day, Naini Lake shimmers in the afternoon sun as boatmen row tourists across the hill resort’s prime attraction nestled amid lush, pine-clothed Himalayan peaks.
examples.zh: 在一个晴朗的十月天，奈尼湖在午后阳光下波光粼粼，船夫划桨载著游客穿过这片山区度假胜地最核心的景观，草木繁茂、松林覆盖的喜马拉雅山峰将其包围。

luxury.definition: n. something that is an indulgence rather than a necessity\nn. wealth as evidenced by sumptuous living
luxury.translation: n. 奢侈, 豪华\na. 奢侈的, 豪华的

examples.en: On the seventh floor, you can find four luxury restaurants.
examples.zh: 在七楼，你可以找到四个豪华餐厅。

examples.en: In the United States the automobile is a necessity and not a luxury.
examples.zh: 在美国，汽车并不是奢华的象征，而是生活的必需品。

examples.en: Advertisements urge us to buy luxuries.
examples.zh: 广告怂恿我们买奢侈品。

labyrinth.definition: n complex system of paths or tunnels in which it is easy to get lost\nn a complex system of interconnecting cavities; concerned with hearing and equilibrium
labyrinth.translation: n. 迷宫, 难解事物, 迷路\n[化] 迷宫; 曲径

examples.en: The road twisted and wound like a labyrinth.
The centipede navigated through the labyrinth of roots.
People are blindly and aimlessly walking in the labyrinth of the present.

laden.definition: s. filled with a great quantity\ns. burdened psychologically or mentally
laden.translation: a. 装满的, 负载的, 苦恼的\nlade的过去分词

examples.en: If Bin Laden comes, tell him I'm in the store.
Summer came and the pear tree was laden with pears.
Americans are celebrating the death of Osama bin Laden.

lapse.definition:
n. a break or intermission in the occurrence of something
v. end, at least for a long time
v. drop to a lower level, as in one's morals or standards
v. let slip
lapse.translation: n. 过失, 流逝, 失效\nvi. 犯错, 堕落, 减退, 消失, 流逝\nvt. 使失效

examples.en: Every time we talk about this, you lapse into silence.
Tom began to lapse in and out of consciousness.
It was a serious lapse in judgment.

laureate.definition: n. someone honored for great achievements; figuratively someone crowned with a laurel wreath\ns. worthy of the greatest honor or distinction
laureate.translation: a. 戴桂冠的, 用月桂树枝编织成的, 荣誉的\nn. 桂冠诗人\nvt. 使戴桂冠

examples.en: Itzhak Rabin was the Nobel Peace Prize laureate for the year 1994.
Professor Reinhard Selten, Nobel laureate in economics, said: Esperanto is good for the mind.

lava.definition: n. rock that in its molten form (as magma) issues from volcanos; lava is what magma is called when it reaches the surface
lava.translation: n. 熔岩, 火山岩\n[医] 火山石(一种顺势疗法药)

examples.en: The mass of lava covered the side of the mountain.
The lava punctured the boat's roof, leaving a gaping hole.
A giant monster made from lava started crawling towards Pietro.

ledge.definition: n. a projecting ridge on a mountain or submerged under water
ledge.translation: n. 突出部分, 暗礁, 矿层

examples.en: The canary is in the cage on the window ledge.
It's impossible to get onto that ledge without rocket jumping.
I fell over a ledge of rock into a gully below.

legion.definition: n. association of ex-servicemen\nn. a large military unit
legion.translation: n. 军团, 军队, 众多的人

examples.en: Tom doesn't know the difference between a phalanx and a legion.
Tom has joined The International Legion for the Defense of Ukraine.
My name is Legion; for we are many.

legislator.definition: n. someone who makes or enacts laws
legislator.translation: n. 立法者, 立法官, 立法委员\n[法] 立法者, 立法机关成员, 立法委员

examples.en: The legislator talked at length with his constituents about beach erosion.
The legislators of that state did away with outdated laws.
The legislators wanted to ban that law.

liaison.definition: n. a channel for communication between groups

examples.en: Administrators need to establish a close liaison with employees.
Layla had a dangerous liaison with a hitman.
What is PALS (Patient Advice and Liaison Service)?

limestone.definition: n. a sedimentary rock consisting mainly of calcium that was deposited by the remains of marine animals
limestone.translation: n. 石灰石\n[化] 石灰石; 石灰岩

examples.en: The piping is clogged up because of the limestone.
Limestone lettuce was developed by James Bibb in 1865.
Limestone underlies most of the site.

lineage.definition: n. the descendants of one individual
lineage.translation: n. 血统, 直系\n[法] 血统, 世系

examples.en: Anna's striking almond-shaped eyes, inherited from her Asian lineage, exude a captivating depth and a hint of mystery.
examples.zh: 安娜引人注目的杏仁状眼睛继承了她的亚洲血统，散发著迷人的深度和一丝神秘感。

liquidate.definition: v. eliminate by paying off (debts)\nv. convert into cash\nv. settle the affairs of by determining the debts and applying the assets to pay them off
liquidate.translation: vt. 偿付, 清算, 扫除, 整理, 变卖, 消灭\nvi. 清算, 清理

examples.en: The Soviet Union tried to liquidate religion from the Soviet life.
The store is closed for good. It's been liquidated.
The store has been liquidated. It's closed for good.

literate.definition:
n. a person who can read and write
a. able to read and write
a. versed in literature; dealing with literature
s. knowledgeable and educated in one or several fields
literate.translation: n. 学者\na. 有读写能力的, 精通文学的, 受过教育的

examples.en: It's absurd how few computer science professors are actually computer literate.
Yanni was barely literate and spoke little Berber.
He asked me to read him the Quran because he wasn't very literate.

litigation.definition: n. a legal proceeding in a court; a judicial contest to determine and enforce legal rights
litigation.translation: n. 诉讼, 起诉\n[经] 诉讼, 纠葛

examples.en: J.K. Rowling uses aggressive litigation to silence her critics.
Death is not the end. There remains the litigation over the estate.
Such litigation can be very costly.

livelihood.definition: n the financial means whereby one lives
livelihood.translation: n. 生计, 营生, 生活

examples.en: The two felt the pressing necessity of earning a livelihood.
The livelihood of the whole family was in danger.
The ordinary people had their livelihood in farming rice.

lofty.definition: s of high moral or intellectual value; elevated in nature or style\ns of imposing height; especially standing out above others\ns having or displaying great dignity or nobility
lofty.translation: a. 高的, 傲慢的, 崇高的, 高级的, 玄虚的

examples.en: No matter what grand and lofty reason you have, it's not right to do this.
examples.zh: 不管你有什么冠冕堂皇的理由，这样做是不对的。

logistics.definition: n. handling an operation that involves providing labor and materials be supplied as needed
logistics.translation: n. 后勤学, 后勤\n[医] 后勤学

examples.en: Amateurs talk strategy, professionals talk logistics.
examples.zh: 外行谈策略，内行谈后勤。

loophole.definition: n. an ambiguity (especially one in the text of a law or contract) that makes it possible to evade a difficulty or obligation\nn. a small hole in a fortified wall; for observation or discharging weapons
loophole.translation: n. 枪眼, 小窗, 换气孔

examples.en: We can't leave the counterparty any loopholes.
examples.zh: 我们不能让对方钻空子。

loot.definition: n. goods or money obtained illegally\nv. take illegally; of intellectual property
loot.translation: n. 赃物, 洗劫, 抢夺\nv. 洗劫, 抢夺

examples.en: We split up the loot among the three of us.
The thieves divvied up the stolen loot among themselves.
The thief outwitted the police and got away with his loot.

lucid.translation: a. 明晰的, 清澈的, 透明的, 透彻的\n[医] 清明的, 透明的, 清醒的

examples.en: Yanni was lucid and aware of what he was doing.
Some artists claim to use lucid dreaming to compose their music.
Do you know how to lucid dream?

lucrative.translation: a. 有利益的, 获利的, 合算的

examples.en: That's how Mary's companies obtained such lucrative urban infrastructure contracts.
Sami began a lucrative career as a diamond trader.
Algeria has rewarded lucrative construction contracts to Chinese companies.

lyric.definition:
n. the text of a popular song or musical-comedy number
n. a short poem of songlike quality
v. write lyrics for (a song)
s. expressing deep emotion
lyric.translation: n. 抒情诗, 歌词\na. 抒情的

examples.en: I found the lyrics, but I can't copy-paste them.
examples.zh: 我找到了歌词，但是没法转贴过来。

examples.en: I like lyric better than epic.
examples.zh: 我喜欢抒情诗多于史诗。

laptop.definition: n. a portable computer small enough to use in your lap

examples.en: Tom sat on his bed and opened his laptop.
examples.zh: 汤姆坐在床上，打开了笔记本电脑。

examples.en: Mary keeps her laptop with her at all times.
examples.zh: 玛丽总是把笔记本电脑带在身上。

examples.en: The laptop provides cutting-edge technology at an affordable price.
examples.zh: 这款笔记型电脑价格亲民，技术领先。

leopard.definition: n. the pelt of a leopard\nn. large feline of African and Asian forests usually having a tawny coat with black spots

examples.en: Have you ever seen a snow leopard hunt in the mountains?
examples.zh: 你见过雪豹在山上狩猎吗？

examples.en: A leopard never changes its spots.
examples.zh: 江山易改，本性难移。

examples.en: I still can't believe they had a snow leopard in that zoo. I thought they were an endangered species.
examples.zh: 我还不敢想象他们在那个动物园里有一个雪豹，我以为它们是一种濒危物种。

lily.definition: n. any liliaceous plant of the genus Lilium having showy pendulous flowers
lily.translation: n. 百合, 百合花\na. 洁白的, 纯白色的, 纯洁的

examples.en: I bought a sprig of lily of the valley.
examples.zh: 我买了一小枝铃兰。

examples.en: A smell of lilies filled the room.
examples.zh: 百合的香气充满了整个房间。

examples.en: The garden was full of purple lilies.
examples.zh: 花园里全是紫百合。

lagoon.definition: n. a body of water cut off from a larger body by a reef of sand or coral
lagoon.translation: n. 环礁湖, 近海岸的浅水区, 泻湖, 咸水湖

examples.en: They hiked through the jungle to reach a secret lagoon.
They say the water swirls in the center of that lagoon.
Venice was built on top of a lagoon.

lieutenant.definition: n. a commissioned military officer\nn. an officer in a police force\nn. an officer holding a commissioned rank in the United States Navy or the United States Coast Guard; below lieutenant commander and above lieutenant junior grade
lieutenant.translation: n. 中尉, 助理人员, 副官

examples.en: Elias calmly informed the lieutenant that he shot his wife.
Lieutenant Dan Anderson was called to a second murder scene.
Thousands turned out to pay their respects to Lieutenant Bakir.

lettuce.definition: n. any of various plants of the genus Lactuca\nn. leaves of any of various plants of Lactuca sativa
lettuce.translation: n. 莴苣, 生菜, 纸币\n[医] 莴苣

examples.en: Hey, Tom, can we get two bins of lettuce?
examples.zh: 嘿，汤姆，我们可以买两箱生菜吗？

examples.en: Tableland vegetables are grown here, such as lettuce, cabbage, and celery.
examples.zh: 这里种植有生菜、高丽菜和芹菜等高原蔬菜。

examples.en: Is it OK to feed my dog lettuce?
examples.zh: 我可以喂狗狗吃生菜吗？

lime.definition: n. any of various related trees bearing limes\nn. the green acidic fruit of any of various lime trees\nv. cover with lime so as to induce growth
lime.translation: n. 石灰, 粘鸟胶, 酸橙\nvt. 以石灰处理, 粘鸟胶于, 撒石灰

examples.en: Crafting a perfect Mojito can be a challenge. Achieving the right balance of sweetness, mintiness, and lime is an art.
examples.zh: 调制一杯完美的 Mojito 并非易事。要达到甜味、薄荷味和青柠味之间的完美平衡，是一门艺术。

lobster.definition: n. flesh of a lobster\nn. any of several edible marine crustaceans of the families Homaridae and Nephropsidae and Palinuridae

examples.en: The sight of fresh lobster gave me an appetite.
examples.zh: 看见新鲜龙虾，我有了食欲。

examples.en: Seeing the fresh lobster made me hungry.
examples.zh: 看见新鲜龙虾，我有了食欲。

examples.en: Let’s order the lobster! I’ve heard that’s the specialty dish here.
examples.zh: 让我们点龙虾！听说是这里的招牌菜。

legislature.definition: n. persons who make or amend or repeal laws
legislature.translation: n. 立法机关, 议会, 立法院\n[法] 立法机构, 立法机关

examples.en: The bill was eviscerated before being passed by the legislature.
Statutory law is written and passed by a legislature.
The country adopted a unicameral legislature to simplify the lawmaking process.

literally.definition: r. in a literal sense\nr. (intensifier before a figurative expression) without exaggeration
literally.translation: adv. 逐字地, 按照字面上地, 不夸张地

examples.en: We know it's difficult, but please don't translate literally.
examples.zh: 我们知道这很困难，但请不要直译。

examples.en: I didn't literally translate from English into Japanese.
examples.zh: 我没有把英语直译成日语。

examples.en: He took it literally.
examples.zh: 他按照字面上的意思。

lace.definition:
n. a cord that is drawn through eyelets or around hooks in order to draw together two edges (as of a shoe or garment)
n. a delicate decorative fabric woven in an open web of symmetrical patterns
v. do lacework
v. draw through eyes or holes
lace.translation:
n. 饰带, 花边, 缎带, 鞋带
vt. 结带子, 饰以花边
vi. 系带子
[计] 全穿孔

examples.en: She has this pretty lace nightgown with straps.
examples.zh: 她的这件吊带蕾丝睡衣很漂亮。

landlady.definition: n. a landlord who is a woman
landlady.translation: n. 女房东, 女地主

examples.en: The two bade adieu to their landlady upon Tuesday, the 4th inst., and departed to Euston Station with the avowed intention of catching the Liverpool express.
examples.zh: 两人于本月 4 日星期二向房东告别，前往尤斯顿车站，决心搭乘开往利物浦的特快列车。

lavatory.definition: n a room or building equipped with one or more toilets\nn a bathroom sink that is permanently installed and connected to a water supply and drainpipe; where you can wash your hands and face\nn a toilet that is cleaned of waste by the flow of water through it

examples.en: We have just cleaned the lavatory.
examples.zh: 我们刚打扫了厕所。

lawful.definition: a. conformable to or allowed by law\ns. according to custom or rule or natural law\ns. authorized, sanctioned by, or in accordance with law
lawful.translation: a. 法律许可的, 守法的, 合法的\n[经] 合法的, 法定的

examples.en: We need to handle this in a lawful manner.
Is it lawful to conscript such young men against their will?
He is the lawful owner of the company.

layman.definition: n. someone who is not a clergyman or a professional person
layman.translation: n. 俗人, 门外汉, 凡人\n[医] 外行, 业外人

examples.en: They are laymen.
examples.zh: 他们是外行。

layoff.definition: n. the act of laying off an employee or a work force
layoff.translation: n. 临时解雇, 操作停止, 活动停止期间

examples.en: Fortunately, the organizational changes did not involve any layoffs.
The private sector is hemorrhaging, with almost all businesses making substantial layoffs.
Research in Motion announced the layoff of 2000 employees and a restructuring of the company.

leaflet.definition: n. part of a compound leaf
leaflet.translation: n. 小叶, 传单\n[医] 小叶

examples.en: Tom put the blue leaflet down on the table.
Tom just didn't want to accept the leaflet.
Tom briefly glanced at the leaflet before throwing it in the trash.

legendary.definition: s. so celebrated as to having taken on the nature of a legend
legendary.translation: a. 传说的, 传奇中说的, 传奇般的, 传说中的, 著名的

examples.en: Bill is still a legendary figure in this company.
examples.zh: Bill 在这间公司仍然是个传奇人物。

legislate.definition: v. make laws, bills, etc. or bring into effect by legislation
legislate.translation: vi. 制定法律\nvt. 用立法规定

examples.en: Governments should not be in the business of legislating morality.
It's not possible to legislate against stupidity.
Why are Senators sitting and not legislating?

legislative.definition: a. relating to a legislature or composed of members of a legislature\na. of or relating to or created by legislation
legislative.translation: n. 立法机构\na. 立法的, 有立法权的

examples.en: In Algeria, thousands of people are running for the June 2021 legislative elections.
examples.zh: 在阿尔及利亚，数千人正在竞选 2021 年 6 月的立法选举。

legitimacy.definition: n. lawfulness by virtue of being authorized or in accordance with law
legitimacy.translation: n. 合法, 正统, 正当\n[法] 合法性, 正统性, 婚生

examples.en: Fair trials ensure the legitimacy of holding war criminals accountable.
After the December 2019 presidential election, Algeria has recovered its political legitimacy.
I don't accept the legitimacy of this government.

lengthy.definition: s relatively long in duration; tediously protracted
lengthy.translation: a. 冗长的, 漫长的

examples.en: It was his lengthy narrative that bored me to death.
The lengthy peace hid the early signs of an explosion.
Ziri's ivy didn't make it through the lengthy road trip.

leniency.definition: n mercifulness as a consequence of being lenient or tolerant\nn a disposition to yield to the wishes of someone\nn lightening a penalty or excusing from a chore by judges or parents or teachers
leniency.translation: n. 宽大, 温和, 慈悲为怀\n[法] 宽大, 宽恕, 仁慈

examples.en: My virtues are called kindness and leniency.
I thank you for your leniency.
Tom asked the judge for leniency.

lenient.definition: s. not strict\ns. characterized by tolerance and mercy
lenient.translation: a. 宽大的, 温和的, 慈悲为怀的\n[法] 宽大的, 仁慈的

examples.en: Leonid received a much more lenient sentence for five years.
Whoever is lenient with the wicked harms the good.
You shouldn't be lenient with those who commit crimes against humanity.

liar.definition: n. a person who has lied or who lies repeatedly

examples.en: That just goes to show that you are a liar.
examples.zh: 这正可以说明你是个骗子。

examples.en: That just goes to prove that you are a liar.
examples.zh: 这正可以说明您是个骗子。

examples.en: A liar needs to have a good memory.
examples.zh: 说谎的人需要很好的记忆力。

limelight.definition: n. a focus of public attention\nn. a lamp consisting of a flame directed at a cylinder of lime with a lens to concentrate the light; formerly used for stage lighting
limelight.translation: n. 石灰光, 石灰光灯, 以石灰光灯照射的舞台\nvt. 使受到注目, 使显露头角

examples.en: Tom is happy to let Mary and John take the limelight.
The vision of the "new German Man" is in the limelight.
I'm not accustomed to being in the limelight.

liner.definition: n. (baseball) a hit that flies straight out from the batter\nn. a piece of cloth that is used as the inside surface of a garment\nn. a large commercial ship (especially one that carries passengers on a regular schedule)
liner.translation: n. 班机, 划线者, 定期船, 衬里\n[化] 衬垫; 垫带; 套管

examples.en: The ocean liner was too big to navigate the narrow passage.
Consider using a drip tray or liner for messier cooking projects.
Mary isn't the only one responsible for the liner running aground.

linguistic.definition: a. consisting of or related to language\na. of or relating to the scientific study of language
linguistic.translation: a. 语言的, 语言学的\n[计] 语言的, 语言学的

examples.en: The zodiac culture is deeply rooted in people's daily life and linguistic culture.
examples.zh: 生肖文化深深植根于人们的日常生活和语言文化中。

examples.en: Using Esperanto with him, I sense that we both are at the same level, at least from a linguistic point of view.
examples.zh: 我和他用世界语沟通，觉得最少从语言的观点来看，我和他的程度是差不多的。

linguistics.definition: n. the scientific study of language\nn. the humanistic study of language and literature

examples.en: He is absorbed in the study of linguistics.
examples.zh: 他沉迷于语言学的研究。

examples.en: Linguistics is a very interesting field.
examples.zh: 语言学是门很有意思的学科。

examples.en: My major is linguistics.
examples.zh: 我的主修是语言学。

linkage.definition:
n. an associative relation
n. (genetics) traits that tend to be inherited together as a consequence of an association between their genes; all of the genes of a given chromosome are linked (where one goes they all go)
n. a mechanical system of rods or springs or pivots that transmits power or motion
n. the act of linking things together
linkage.translation: n. 联合, 连锁, 结合, 联动\n[计] 连接

examples.en: The 15-member Security Council heard repeated references to the linkage between poverty and conflict throughout the world.
Four-bar linkages are used in a huge variety of applications, from car suspensions to folding chairs.
Not far away, screened by the forest, crouched Shiegra, the lioness, intent upon devouring the infant for her evening meal.
examples.zh: 不远处，母狮谢格拉匍匐著，隐匿于林间，正伺机将婴儿吞食，作为她的晚餐。

liquor.definition: n. an alcoholic beverage that is distilled rather than fermented\nn. a liquid substance that is a solution (or emulsion or suspension) used or obtained in an industrial process\nn. the liquid in which vegetables or meat have be cooked
liquor.translation: n. 酒, 液体, 汁, 溶液\nvt. 浸水\nvi. 喝酒

examples.en: I want to be able to hold my liquor better.
examples.zh: 想酒量大一些。

examples.en: Lips that touch liquor shall not touch mine.
examples.zh: 碰过酒的嘴唇就别想碰我的唇。

locker.definition: n. a fastener that locks or closes
locker.translation: n. 抽屉, 小柜, 上锁人\n[机] 锁柜

examples.en: While swimming in the pool, she lost her locker key.
examples.zh: 她在游泳池游泳的时候把储物柜的钥匙弄丢了。

examples.en: Jayjay ran into John in the locker room.
examples.zh: 杰杰在更衣室碰到了约翰。

examples.en: Tom left a note in Mary's locker.
examples.zh: 汤姆在玛丽亚的储物柜里留下了一张纸条。

logistic.definition: a. of or relating to logistics
logistic.translation: a. 逻辑的, 后勤学的

examples.en: The influence of covariates on the primary outcome variable was explored using logistic regression.

logistical.definition: a of or relating to logistics
logistical.translation: a. 逻辑的; 后勤方面的

examples.en: Algeria is trying to become an important logistical hub in Africa.
Algeria should become an important logistical center.
The second-class quartermaster is an experienced sailor responsible for technical or logistical duties.

logo.definition: n. a company emblem or device
logo.translation: n. 连合活字, 商标, 徽标\n[计] 徽标

examples.en: You can withdraw money from ATMs that have the "UnionPay" logo.
examples.zh: 你可以到有“银联”标志的ATM机里去取钱。

examples.en: The sidebar is displayed on the edge of the page below the site logo.
examples.zh: 侧边栏显示在网站标志下方的页面边缘。

longevity.definition: n. duration of service\nn. the property of being long-lived
longevity.translation: n. 长命, 长寿, 寿命\n[医] 长寿

examples.en: If you aim for longevity, think about giving up smoking.
The barber needs to increase the longevity of his towels.
The secret of longevity is to choose your parents carefully.

longitude.definition: n. the angular distance between a point on any meridian and the prime meridian at Greenwich
longitude.translation: n. 经度, 经线\n[电] 经度

examples.en: This line represents the longitude.
examples.zh: 这条线代表经度。

longitudinal.definition: a. of or relating to lines of longitude\ns. running lengthwise\ns. over an extended time
longitudinal.translation: a. 经度的, 经线的, 纵的\n[医] 纵的

examples.en: A longitudinal wave is one that vibrates in the direction of propagation.
Sound propagates via longitudinal waves.

lotion.definition: n. any of various cosmetic preparations that are applied to the skin\nn. liquid preparation having a soothing or antiseptic or medicinal action when applied to the skin

examples.en: Can you put some suntan lotion on my back?
examples.zh: 你能在我的背上涂些防晒霜吗？

luminous.translation: a. 发光的, 明亮的\n[医] 发光的

examples.en: Tom wants to paint the windowsills with luminous paint.
They all agreed that it was a huge creature, luminous, ghastly, and spectral.
Painful and murderous war is purple, the color of peace is a luminous sky blue.
Is it too early to order from the luncheon menu?
It was a good luncheon, as hotels go.
Ah, Superintendent Chalmers! Welcome. I hope you're prepared for an unforgettable luncheon!

leading.definition: s. indicating the most important performer or role\ns. greatest in importance or degree or significance or achievement\na. going or proceeding or going in advance; showing the way
leading.translation: n. 领导, 指挥, 神示, 铅板\na. 领导的, 主要的, 在前的

examples.en: He is leading an easy life in the country.
examples.zh: 他在乡村里过著无忧无虑的生活。

examples.en: Tom is an archaeologist leading the excavations near Rome.
examples.zh: 汤姆是位考古学家，在领导罗马附近的发掘项目。

examples.en: Palm oil production is the leading cause of deforestation in Indonesia.
examples.zh: 棕榈油制造是导致印度尼西亚森林砍伐的主要原因。

lightning.definition: n. abrupt electric discharge from cloud to cloud or from cloud to earth accompanied by the emission of light\nn. the flash of light that accompanies an electric discharge in the atmosphere (or something resembling such a flash); can scintillate for a second or more
lightning.translation: n. 闪电\nvi. 闪电\na. 闪电的

examples.en: Are you afraid of nights with thunder and lightning?
examples.zh: 妳怕不怕雷电交加的夜晚？

examples.en: If you swear reckless oaths, lightning will strike you.
examples.zh: 乱发誓会遭雷劈的。

examples.en: Tom has been struck by lightning three times.
examples.zh: 汤姆被闪电击中过三次。

lounge.definition: n. a room (as in a hotel or airport) with seating where people can wait\nv. sit or recline comfortably
lounge.translation: n. 闲逛, 休闲室, 长沙发\nvi. 闲混, (懒洋洋地)躺\nvt. 闲混

examples.en: Tom came into the lounge, carrying a cup of coffee.
Fyodor and Rima were hanging out in the lounge area.
Mary stretched out on a lounge chair besides the pool.

luckily.translation: adv. 幸运地, 幸亏, 侥幸

examples.en: Luckily he had enough money to pay the bill.
examples.zh: 幸运的是他有足够的钱来付账。

examples.en: I got to the bank and luckily didn't have to get in line.
examples.zh: 我到银行去，很幸运地不必排队。

examples.en: Luckily, we found an escape route.
examples.zh: 幸运的是，我们找到了逃生通道。

luxurious.definition: s displaying luxury and furnishing gratification to the senses\ns rich and superior in quality
luxurious.translation: a. 豪华的, 奢侈的, 放纵的

examples.en: The new theatre looks very luxurious.
examples.zh: 新剧院看上去很豪华。

lab.definition: n. a workplace for the conduct of scientific research
lab.translation: n. 实验室, 研究室\n[医] 凝乳酶

examples.en: The air conditioner in the lab is broken.
examples.zh: 实验室里的空调坏了。

examples.en: The natural world is always much more complex than formulations in the lab or blueprints in the design office.
examples.zh: 自然界从来都比试验室的配方或设计院的图纸里所反映的要复杂得多。

labour.definition:
n a social class comprising those who do manual labor or work for wages
n concluding state of pregnancy; from the onset of contractions to the birth of a child
n a political party formed in Great Britain in 1900; characterized by the promotion of labor's interests and formerly the socialization of key industries
n productive work (especially physical work done for wages)
v work hard
v strive and make an effort to reach a goal
v undergo the efforts of childbirth
labour.translation: n. 劳动, 努力, 工作, 劳工, 分娩\nvi. 劳动, 努力, 苦干\nvt. 详细分析, 使厌烦

examples.en: I'm unable to do manual labour.
examples.zh: 我不能做体力劳动。

lamentation.definition: n. the passionate and demonstrative activity of expressing grief

landing.definition:
n. an intermediate platform in a staircase
n. structure providing a place where boats can land people or goods
n. the act of coming down to the earth (or other surface)
n. the act of coming to land after a voyage
landing.translation: n. 登陆, 码头, 降落\n[经] 上岸, 登陆, 降落

examples.en: My grandpa believes that the moon landing was a hoax.
examples.zh: 我的祖父相信登月是一个骗局。

examples.en: The plane is landing in Tan Son Nhat airport.
examples.zh: 飞机降落在新山一机场。

examples.en: In a few minutes we'll be landing at New Tokyo International Airport.
examples.zh: 我们将于几分钟内降落在新东京国际机场。

later.definition: s. coming at a subsequent time or stage\nr. comparative of the adverb `late'

examples.en: A week later, John asked Jessica out on a date.
examples.zh: 一周后，约翰约洁西卡出去约会。

examples.en: Read such books as will be useful in later life.
examples.zh: 读这样的书会对今后的生活会有用。

examples.en: I wasn't very hungry, so I decided to eat later.
examples.zh: 因为我不是很饿，所以我决定晚点吃。

lathe.definition: n. machine tool for shaping metal or wood; the workpiece turns about a horizontal axis against a fixed tool
lathe.translation: n. 车床\nvt. 用车床加工

examples.en: I've never used a lathe before. Could you show me how?
I've never used a lathe before.
Ali's grandpa was a lathe operator.

lattice.definition: n. an arrangement of points or particles or objects in a regular periodic pattern in 2 or 3 dimensions\nn. framework consisting of an ornamental design made of strips of wood or metal
lattice.translation: n. 格子, 组合格子, 格子状东西\nvt. 制做格子, 使成格子状\n[计] 格

examples.en: A lattice is an abstract structure studied in the mathematical subdisciplines of order theory and abstract algebra.
French physicists have successfully tested two optical lattice clocks, which would lose just one second every 300 million years.

leakage.definition: n the discharge of a fluid from some container
leakage.translation: n. 漏, 漏出物, 泄漏\n[化] 漏电; 漏水; 漏气; 渗漏; 漏失量; 漏出量

examples.en: There has been some leakage behind the bathtub.
It is difficult to determine the state and safety of the radiation leakage.

learning.definition: n. the cognitive process of acquiring skill or knowledge
learning.translation: n. 学问, 学识, 学习\n[计] 学习

examples.en: Language learning brings a lot of joy in our life.
examples.zh: 学语言是人生中的一大乐事。

examples.en: She had no difficulty in learning the poem by heart.
examples.zh: 她轻而易举的就把诗背熟了。

examples.en: Your homework is one important part of the learning experience.
examples.zh: 家庭作业是学习中很重要的一部分。

lengthen.definition: v. make longer\nv. become long or longer
lengthen.translation: vt. 加长, 使延长\nvi. 变长

examples.en: Being optimistic could lengthen your life, a new study suggests.
The coat is a bit too short. Can you lengthen it?
The sleeves of this coat have to be lengthened.

lest.definition: s being ten more than forty
lest.translation: conj. 以免, 唯恐, 免得

examples.en: You must do all you can lest you should regret later.
examples.zh: 你必须尽一切可能尽力而为, 免得你以后后悔。

examples.en: We came in through the back door lest someone should see us.
examples.zh: 我们不想给人看见，所以就从后门走了进去。

examples.en: I dare not probe too deeply, lest I uncover the awful truth!
examples.zh: 我不敢探查得太深, 以免发现可怕的事实。

liberation.definition: n. the act of liberating someone or something\nn. the attempt to achieve equal rights or status
liberation.translation: n. 释放, 解放\n[化] 发出; 释放; 放出

examples.en: Is death the only way to liberation?
examples.zh: 死亡是唯一可能的解脱吗？

librarian.definition: n. a professional person trained in library science and engaged in library services
librarian.translation: n. 图书馆员, 图书管理员\n[计] 程序库管理程序; 程序库生成程序

examples.en: I am employed as a librarian in an academic library.
His mother works as a librarian at a private school.
The librarian told Tom and Mary to be quiet.

licence.definition:
n excessive freedom; lack of due restraint
n freedom to deviate deliberately from normally applicable rules or practices (especially in behavior or speech)
n a legal document giving official permission to do something
v authorize officially
licence.translation: n. 执照, 许可证, 特许\nvt. 许可, 特许, 认可

examples.en: She is not old enough to get a driving licence.
examples.zh: 她没到拿驾照的年龄。

examples.en: He got his driving licence in less time than anyone.
examples.zh: 他比任何人用更短的时间拿到驾照。

examples.en: My mother has a driving licence, but she doesn't drive.
examples.zh: 我母亲有驾照，但是她不开车。

lick.definition: n. touching with the tongue\nv. pass the tongue over
lick.translation: n. 舔, 少许, 打\nvt. 舔, 卷过, 鞭打\nvi. 轻轻拍打

examples.en: The others have already licked the bottom of the pot.
examples.zh: 其他人已经舔干净锅底了。

examples.en: Kissing a person who smokes is like licking an ashtray.
examples.zh: 亲吻一个抽烟的人就像在舔烟灰缸。

examples.en: Life is like licking honey off a cactus.
examples.zh: 生活就像是舔仙人掌上的蜂蜜。

lighten.definition:
v. make more cheerful
v. reduce the weight on; make lighter
v. become more cheerful
v. become lighter
lighten.translation: vt. 照亮, 点亮, 减轻, 使轻松, 闪出\nvi. 发亮, 打闪, 变轻

examples.en: It was just a joke. Lighten up!
examples.zh: 只是个玩笑。放松点!

examples.en: For God's sake Bob, lighten up.
examples.zh: 我求你了，鲍勃，放轻松点。

lighter.definition: n. a device for lighting or igniting fuel or charges or fires\nv. transport in a flatbottom boat
lighter.translation: n. 点火者, 点灯工人, 打火机, 驳船\nvt. 以驳船搬运

examples.en: Women eat lighter meals when they're eating with a guy.
examples.zh: 当女性跟一个男人吃饭时，女性会吃得比较少。

examples.en: Is it a bit lighter or a bit heavier?
examples.zh: 轻一点还是重一点？

examples.en: Sir, you have left your lighter on the table.
examples.zh: 先生，您把您的打火机留在桌子上了。

lightly.definition:
r. without good reason
r. with few burdens
r. with little weight or force
r. indulging with temperance
lightly.translation: adv. 轻轻地, 少许, 不费力地

examples.en: The other team took us lightly.
examples.zh: 另外一队轻视了我们。

examples.en: Put it down lightly!
examples.zh: 轻一点儿放！

likeness.definition: n. similarity in appearance or character or nature between persons or things\nn. picture consisting of a graphic image of a person or thing
likeness.translation: n. 相象, 相似物, 样子

examples.en: Humans created gods in their own image and likeness.
He bears a strong likeness to my son.
A painter could not better describe his likeness.

limited.definition:
a. small in range or scope
s. including only a part
s. mediocre
s. not excessive
limited.translation: a. 有限制的, 有限的, 有限责任的\nn. 特别快车

examples.en: Recently, this brand launched a series of limited edition underwear.
examples.zh: 最近这个品牌推出了一系列限量版内衣。

examples.en: In towns, speed is limited to 50 km/h.
examples.zh: 在市区内，速度被限制在每小时五十公里以内。

examples.en: Our company is a limited company.
examples.zh: 我们公司是有限公司。

lining.definition: n. a protective covering that protects an inside surface\nn. providing something with a surface of a different material\nn. the act of attaching an inside lining (to a garment or curtain etc.)
lining.translation: n. 衬里, 内层, 衬垫\n[化] 衬里; 衬垫; 衬套; 衬层

examples.en: They are lining up for the bus.
examples.zh: 他们排队等公车。

examples.en: Every cloud has a silver lining.
examples.zh: 每朵云都披著银衣。

examples.en: So it seems that cloud of odorless deadly gas had a silver lining after all.
examples.zh: 只能说，致命煤气的雾团中，也定会有阳光的。

lipstick.definition: n. makeup that is used to color the lips\nv. form by tracing with lipstick\nv. apply lipstick to
lipstick.translation: n. 口红, 唇膏\n[机] 口红

examples.en: Brian bought some lipstick for Kate.
examples.zh: 布莱恩买了一些口红给凯特。

examples.en: It takes a great man to be a good listener.
What is music for you, listener, and for you, performer?
He is a good listener but a poor speaker.

liter.definition: n. a metric unit of capacity, formerly defined as the volume of one kilogram of pure water under standard conditions; now equal to 1,000 cubic centimeters (or approximately 1.75 pints)

examples.en: This car can go thirteen kilometers for every liter of gasoline.
examples.zh: 这辆车每升油能跑十三公里。

examples.en: The rules now under review require an average of 54.5 miles per gallon (23 kilometers per liter) from an automaker's entire fleet by 2025.
examples.zh: 目前正在审查的规则要求，到 2025 年，汽车制造商所制造的所有汽车，平均续航须达到每加仑 54.5 英里 (每公升 23 公里)。

living-room.definition: n a room in a private house or establishment where people can sit and talk and relax

examples.en: The living-room windows have been open for hours.
He admitted the visitor to the living-room.
We have a living-room.

loaf.definition: n. a quantity of food (other than bread) formed in a particular shape
loaf.translation: n. 一条面包, 块, 游荡\nv. 游手好闲, 虚度光阴

examples.en: A moldy loaf of bread lay on the table.
examples.zh: 台子上有个发霉的面包。

examples.en: A loaf of bread is better than the songs of birds.
examples.zh: 面包比鸟的鸣唱好。

examples.en: Half a loaf is better than none.
examples.zh: 半个面包总比没有好。

locality.definition: n a surrounding or nearby region
locality.translation: n. 地方, 所在, 位置\n[法] 位置, 场所, 地区

examples.en: The locality does not count for much in Japan.
It was known as the Brown House by the people of the locality.
An aguish climate made inhabitants travel to healthier localities.

locust.definition: n. migratory grasshoppers of warm regions having short antennae\nn. hardwood from any of various locust trees
locust.translation: n. 蝗虫, 蚱蜢, 蝉

examples.en: That's not a grasshopper. It's a locust!
examples.zh: 那不是蚂蚱。是蝗虫！

lodging.translation: n. 寄宿处, 寄宿\n[法] 提起, 住所

examples.en: This building is a capsule hotel lodging men and women.
examples.zh: 那个建筑物是男女都可以住宿的胶囊酒店。

longing.definition: n. prolonged unfulfilled desire or need
longing.translation: n. 渴望, 热望, 憧憬\na. 渴望的, 热望的

examples.en: We are all longing for peace in the world.
examples.zh: 谁都希望世界和平。

examples.en: In literary works, night-blooming jasmine is often used to symbolize longing and tenderness.
examples.zh: 文学作品中常用夜来香来象征思念与柔情。

examples.en: We are longing for world peace.
examples.zh: 我们希望世界和平。

loosely.definition: r. in a relaxed manner; not rigid\nr. in a loose manner\nr. knitted in a loose manner
loosely.translation: adv. 松弛地, 宽松地, 不紧

examples.en: Berber, an Afroasiatic language, is loosely related to Semitic languages.
The Berber expression "azul fell-awen" loosely translated means "greetings upon you."
Simeon used the term Lumpenproletariat too loosely, applying it to anyone poor.

loosen.definition: v. make loose or looser\nv. make less dense\nv. become loose or looser or less tight
loosen.translation: vt. 放松, 松开, 解除\nvi. 变松, 松弛

examples.en: Loosen up on the gas pedal. You're driving too fast.
To loosen a screw, turn it to the left.
You need to loosen up and have some fun.

lorry.definition: n. a large low horse-drawn wagon without sides\nn. a large truck designed to carry heavy loads; usually without sides
lorry.translation: n. 卡车, 货车\n[化] 载重汽车

examples.en: In Britain a truck is referred to as a lorry.
examples.zh: 英国人把货车叫作「lorry」。

examples.en: I was almost hit by a lorry.
examples.zh: 我差点被卡车撞到。

loudspeaker.definition: n. electro-acoustic transducer that converts electrical signals into sounds loud enough to be heard at a distance
loudspeaker.translation: n. 扩音器, 喇叭\n[电] 扬声器

examples.en: Yanni called his wife in front of everyone on loudspeaker.
The voice on the loudspeaker was too muffled to understand.
The police used a drone with a loudspeaker to disperse the crowd.

lover.definition: n. a person who loves someone or is loved by someone\nn. a significant other to whom you are not related by marriage

examples.en: She was seen at a restaurant with her lover.
examples.zh: 有人看到了她在饭馆跟她爱人在一起。

examples.en: The two lovers swore to love each other for eternity.
examples.zh: 两个恋人发誓永远相爱。

examples.en: He is a lover of sports.
examples.zh: 他是一个体育爱好者。
